"I hope so…," Joe answered. "Now stop talking to me. I need to concentrate."
*
Outside, the battle continued. Wilted cast Grim Reaper's level 60 spell, Soul Trap. This spell created a link that tethered an enemy to a target location. Wilted's max-leveled spell could tether a maximum of ten enemies. But currently, they only fought Leviathan, so only the devil was tethered.
Tethered enemies affected by this spell couldn't go further than thirty meters from the tethered location, which Wilted placed at one spot in the sky. At max level, the furthest distance the enemies could move was only ten meters away from the tethered location.
This ultimately anchored Leviathan to a spot. Additionally, all the damage suffered by the tethered enemies would fill the caster's soul orb, even if said caster was far away. This soul trap lasted one minute at its first level and five minutes at its maximum level.
Leviathan was angry for getting anchored. He pulled to release himself. But despite his overwhelming strength, the link refused to let go. It was getting thinner, though, due to the pressure from Leviathan's pull. A normal enemy might be trapped for the spell's full duration, but that was unlikely to happen against a powerful being such as Leviathan. Even one minute was already a stretch.
Leviathan was frustrated when the soul trap didn't let go immediately when he heaved. In his fury, he used another of his special skills. Countless things started to fly out of his body. Those things were the Remoron Bugs. Leviathan shared his mana to give these bugs the ability to fly and leave his body for a period.
These bugs scattered to engage the enemies.
Wilted and the others were aware Leviathan had this ability. They were prepared. Anotherday used Veiled Demon Slayer's level 50 skill, Protective Chakrams. Five chakrams flew out and revolved around his body. They dealt damage and knocked all hostiles that came into the user's melee range. He followed up with Concealed Needle, which struck all the Remoron Bugs in his vicinity.
Wilted used her buff spell, which was Grim Reaper's level 70 spell, Presence of the Reaper. This spell absorbed HP from all hostiles while healing all allies within range. It was similar to Reaver's Haunting Ground spell but covered a much larger area. It also lasted longer and followed the caster around.
She then cast Grim Reaper's level 80 spell, Conversion of Souls. This spell dealt 500% soul damage to a target area. This area was marked for the remainder of the battle. Anyone who suffered damage within this area contributed to the caster's soul orb, even if the caster was far away. Caster could also heal allies within this area even when these allies were not within the soul orb's range, providing she could see them, of course.
Wilted placed this spell where it also touched Leviathan, so the devil received the soul damage. With all the damage from her spells, her soul orbs quickly filled. She used them to heal Anotherday, Brave King, and Mazin, who were surrounded by the Remoron Bugs.
While Leviathan was immobilized, Wilted cast Grim Reaper's level 90 spell, Reaper's Touch. The spell dealt 2500% soul damage to a target. It had a 30% chance of an instant-kill effect. This instant-kill effect was useless against Leviathan. Even so, the devil received a debuff, the same as any target who survived the instant kill. The debuff caused the target's stats and defenses to reduce by 10% for the remainder of the battle. This debuff effect was not stackable. If Leviathan was hit again by Reaper's Touch, its stats and defenses would not reduce any further.
In the case that the target was killed by Reaper's Touch, the caster received a second fully-filled soul orb. This second soul orb lasted five minutes, similar to Reaver's Soul Annihilation, which Wilted also cast on Leviathan to add to the damage.
Leviathan was furious at being a punching bag while unable to move. He discharged wind blades to strike all the opponents, particularly Wilted. Wilted was standing on Mothership Sigma. The mothership had a barrier similar to Paytowin's. One had to deplete its shield bar before it received damage to its HP. This barrier shielded Wilted from Leviathan's wind blades.
Suddenly, a circular portal materialized beside Leviathan's mouth. Out of this portal, Paytowin and Joe emerged.
"What…?!" Leviathan couldn't believe what he saw.
Before Leviathan registered the situation, the two hurriedly fled to a safe distance.
"Graahhh…!!!" Leviathan roared in anger. He didn't believe he got played like this. His anger augmented his strength. Wilted's Soul Trap couldn't hold the devil any longer. It finally fizzled. Leviathan was free.
He opened his mouth, and a Soul Lasso shot out. It was not the thin version shot from his tentacles but the thick one that could drag even the Omega Battle Mech. Leviathan originally planned to use this Soul Lasso to catch Mothership Sigma, but he instead aimed this skill at the two fleeing outworlders. It was a waste to use this skill on them, but he was too pissed to care right now.
Luckily, the duration of Spectral Doors was not yet over. Joe hurriedly placed a portal behind them once he saw Leviathan open his mouth in their direction. The Soul Lasso shot into this portal. The other portal was placed right next to Leviathan's head. The soul lasso came out of that portal and slapped Leviathan's own head.
Leviathan growled. He almost couldn't contain his anger. Getting played twice, he had to tear those two outworlders to pieces to assuage his fury. But before he could chase the two, a massive torrent of water washed over him. A huge shadow within the water slammed into him and caused him to reel.
"Meratis!" Wilted called. The one who had butted in was Meratis and the Caelum Whale.
"The Caelum Whale is not fully healed yet, but I see you can use the help," Meratis replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1905. Hot-headed Lunatic
chapters.content:
Chapter 1905. Hot-headed Lunatic
At the Southern Aurebor Front, the Verremor army held the defensive line fearlessly. The orcs were a race with unusual battle lust. They were not easily intimidated, even when the enemies outnumbered or outpowered them. Additionally, they were reinforced by their national treasure, the Totem Banner.
Water Lily was in charge of the Totem Banner, while the ten war banners that received the Totem Banner's effects were entrusted to the field commanders who spread out on the battlefield. Water Lily herself was working on the war table, organizing the army for an effective defense.
She was so focused on what she was doing, and everyone had been running around the place all the time, that she didn't sense someone coming behind her.
"How's the battle going?"
Water Lily was startled by the question. She turned and saw Four Winds. Leavemealone, Arthur Bagrat, and Blackhole stood behind Four Winds. The bodyguards protecting Water Lily and the war table let them pass since Four Winds was the Grand Chief.
"Grand Chief!" Umeza Giantkiller called. He was in charge of the security around Water Lily. He was fighting a demon who tried to get to the war table. He gave the demon a roundhouse kick that sent the demon away. He ordered his pet, the three-headed wolf, to deal with the demon while he came to Four Winds.
"It's about time you come," Water Lily said to Four Winds. She talked while returning her attention to the war table. "Want to take over? I honestly don't know how to turn things around. I might need to issue a retreat if the situation doesn't change."
"I can't. You need to keep steering the army. I have to deal with another thing," Four Winds answered.
"Other things like what?" Water Lily asked.
"Like defeating Asmodeus," Four Winds answered. He was observing the map above the war table. It was easy to identify Asmodeus' position on that map. The devil was represented by the largest red dot.
"My regiment and I will follow you to battle the devil," Umeza declared.
"No. Your regiment stays here and protects this place," Four Winds ordered. To Water Lily, he said, "I need you to rearrange the troops to keep the other demons away from Asmodeus. I want to focus on Asmodeus without interruption."
"That will be difficult. Despite his size, that devil is very fast," Water Lily answered. "Plus, the other sides of this defensive line will weaken if I retask the troops to focus on the area around Asmodeus. We might end up having to retreat earlier."
"We won't be retreating anymore," Four Winds announced.
Water Lily turned to Four Winds again. She was trying to check if he was joking. Four Winds was displaying his regular serious face.
Four Winds saw the skepticism in Water Lily's expression. He added, "We will be making our stand here. There will be no more retreat. We will defeat the devil. It's time to go all out!"
"Grand Chief, maybe that is too hasty?" Umeza said. "Please don't underestimate Asmodeus. You haven't seen the devil in action. He is not an opponent who can be defeated simply by using more troops. We have lost a lot of good orc warriors who tried to do that. The ones who can face Asmodeus are the hi-ranked members from the Council of Hybris. Even they lost quite many members already. Currently, they simply tried to keep him at bay instead of trying to defeat him."
"I'm not fighting him using more troops," Four Winds said. "The troops' task is to deal with the nearby demons. I will fight Asmodeus with my three friends."
"Three?" Umeza asked.
"Yes, three. These are…," Four Winds was about to introduce the three that came with him but found that only Arthur and Blackhole were behind him.
"Where did Haon go?" Four Winds asked.
Arthur and Blackhole looked back. Leavemealone stood at the rearmost. They were also not aware that Leavemealone was gone.
"That kid's mana concealment had reached this stage. Impressive," Arthur said. "The youngsters these days are truly something else."
After learning Jack had mastered mana concealment, Leavemealone asked Domon to teach him. At that time, Wong was already Domon's good friend. Wong, who was more experienced in mana concealment, volunteered to aid in the training. With Leavemealone's determination and talent, he successfully learned the ability.
"Uh… I think he is heading to Asmodeus," Water Lily said. She pointed at a green dot on the map. That green dot was moving at a high speed to the big red dot representing Asmodeus.
"He must have left after learning Asmodeus' location from that map," Blackhole said.
"Damned that hot-headed lunatic…," Four Winds cursed.
"We can't let him fight the devil alone," Arthur said. He used his wings tool and flew toward where Asmodeus was.
Blackhole went after Arthur without saying anything.
"Some troublesome teammates you have there. Are you going to be okay, boss?" Water Lily asked.
Four Winds put a hand on his temple and shook his head. "Sigh… I guess I will have to be the one adjusting to their rhythm."
"Grand Chief, are you sure you don't need my regiment's aid?" Umeza asked again.
"Don't worry. Despite how they act, they are capable combatants. We will not lose. Let me repeat, we will not retreat again."
Four Winds used his wings tool and floated up. As he did, he pumped mana manipulation into his voice. His words reverberated throughout the battlefield, "Verremor warriors! This is your grand chief speaking! We will defeat the devil and drive back the demons on this battlefield. From now on, there will be no retreat. We will only advance! Steel yourself, my warriors! For victory is at hand! For the glory of Verremor…!!!"
The orcish soldiers who heard the rally responded with valorous cries. Their battle cry echoed throughout the battlefield.
Water Lily, who was watching the projection over the war table, was impressed to see the army morale which had fallen to almost 50, rose back to above 70. She smiled after seeing the number.
'That's our guild leader for you,' she thought.
*
Asmodeus' man-head turned in the direction where the mana-empowered voice was coming from. He snickered after hearing the declaration. "No longer retreating? Such a boastful statement," He muttered.
He then turned his attention back to the four natives battling him. All of them were members of the Council of Hybris. They had lost countless members during this war. They had even lost one of their leaders just two days ago. Balrd had fallen. Only Petunia was left.
The radiant peafowl also almost died earlier. Petunia forced it to retreat to heal its wound first. It was unwilling but finally yielded to Petunia's demand and retreated. As for Quetzalcoatl, he was helping the other side of the battlefield. Most of his skills were lightning-based. They were very ineffective against Asmodeus.
After Balrd's demise, Petunia wished to halt Asmodeus' advance all by herself due to her pride, but a squad of high-level members of the Council of Hybris came to her aid. These members weren't going to lose both their leaders, even if it meant leaving the other parts of the battlefield weakened.
That squad was now down to only four, including Petunia. Two of the four were level 85 mythical grades. These two had their HPs at critical already. The remaining one specialized in healing spells. She tried to heal her two comrades, but Asmodeus cast Interrupt, and her casting failed.
Asmodeus' bird claws went in a flash and stomped one of the mythical combatants. That stomp was using a skill. It caused a localized earthquake. The combatant died after the stomp.
The other one received splash damage but not that bad since he successfully dodged from getting a direct stomping. His accomplishment didn't last long, though. Asmodeus' serpent tail shot a lightning bolt that pierced him. He lost his life after that assault.
Petunia never stopped firing using her bowgun, but Asmodeus ignored her attacks. Asmodeus had a magic shield empowered by lightning that blocked her attacks. Normally, Magic Shield only reduced damage, but Asmodeus' Lightning Shield had runic symbols reinforcing it. This Lightning Shield blocked Petunia's shots completely. None of her arrows hit the devil.
"Aneid, get back!" Petunia told her healer comrade. She was casting a spell while firing her bowgun. The spell was now completed. A black hole appeared near Asmodeus. While a black hole was inherently dark, this one had darkness-element infused to it. This dark black hole pulled at Asmodeus while causing dark-element damage.
Asmodeus didn't appear perturbed by the spell. He shoved one of his bird claws into the black hole. He then squeezed. The black hole distorted until eventually, it was ripped apart.
Petunia was taken aback. She couldn't believe Asmodeus could end her spell by force.
"Without your partner, you are nothing," Asmodeus mocked. "Perhaps it's time I end this game and send you to reunite with him."
Petunia's HP was also not well. She was below 30% HP. Aneid tried her best to heal Petunia, but her healings were not fast enough.
When Asmodeus was preparing three spells simultaneously to make good on his threat, a high-pitched screech was heard. He turned to the source and saw something that looked like a firebird coming at him at high speed.
"Hmph! Another plaything?" Asmodeus snorted. He changed one of his spells back into the lightning shield to block this newcomer.
The firebird crashed into the runic-empowered lightning shield. While the lightning shield seemed to hold, Asmodeus sensed a sudden spike of mana. Something that looked like a dark drill pierced through his lightning shield. A raging flame burst through the hole caused by this dark drill. That flame transformed into a flaming tiger head.
This flaming tiger head slammed into Asmodeus' man-head. As it did, Asmodeus felt like he had been punched by a giant fist. His head reeled back from the punch. His two other spells ended mid-casting, and he was forced a couple of steps back from the impact.

chapters.title: Chapter 1906. Facing the Devil Alone
chapters.content:
Chapter 1906. Facing the Devil Alone
The one who had landed a punch on Asmodeus' face was none other than Leavemealone. He used the Nine-Yin Abyssal Finger to pierce Asmodeus' lightning shield, before using Tiger Punch to land the hit.
He was in white tiger emperor form. The form was buffed with both white tiger claws and white tiger rage. Flames enshrouded his body. On his back was a pair of flaming wings. This was not the wings from a wings tool. Both the flames covering his body and the wings were Suzaki's flames.
Leavemealone didn't waste the opportunity when Asmodeus was still dazed by the attack. His body spun at high speed as he performed another martial art he learned from Domon, the Whirlwind Kick. Suzaki's flames followed his movement, creating a flaming hurricane that both empowered the martial art's power and increased the damage it inflicted. Asmodeus had to take another step back as his heads received repeated kicks.
"Enough!" Asmodeus hollered. A shockwave erupted from him. The force repelled Leavemealone, stopping his assault.
Asmodeus' bird foreleg came up in the attempt to catch Leavemealone, but Leavemealone's reaction was fast enough. Leavemealone activated Illusive Form. He left myriad afterimages as he moved away. Asmodeus' claw only caught his illusion.
Leavemealone stopped a distance away. Petunia and Aneid were stunned by Leavemealone's sudden intrusion into the fight. They just stood there and watched.
"An outworlder…," Asmodeus massaged his man-head with his claw. "Do you have a death wish?"
Leavemealone answered by using Ki Bullet. The energy ball he fired was coated in thick fire. It made the Ki Bullet look like a giant fireball.
"Audacious! Since you wish to die so much, let me fulfill your wish!" Asmodeus rushed forward. A swing of his foreleg destroyed the fire-shrouded ki bullet, but Leavemealone was already gone when Asmodeus arrived.
Asmodeus sensed Leavemealone circling behind him. His dragon hindlegs went up attempting a double kick, but Leavemealone's reaction allowed him to dodge. Asmodeus' snake-tail followed up by firing a lightning bolt, but that also missed.
Frustrated, Asmodeus chased after Leavemealone. The two went in circles like cat and mouse, clashing at high speed. Leavemealone's two hands were powered by the Fire-infused Fist. The flames were further boosted by Suzaki's flames. His punches with all the buffs were strong enough to clash with Asmodeus' claws. When the two collided, Leavemealone was pushed away but suffered no damage.
His Fire-infused Fist no longer had a duration or cooldown. This was one of the passive abilities of his pinnacle class, the Supreme Fist. His fists would always enshroud in flames as long as combat was ongoing.
Petunia couldn't believe a single outworlder could make Asmodeus focus his attention. She snapped out of her trance and resumed firing her gunbow while casting a spell. She also yelled at Aneid, who hurriedly resumed healing her.
"Who is that outworlder?" Aneid asked.
"Don't know…," Petunia answered. She was displeased at herself for feeling the relief of having someone outside of her faction helping the fight. But after suffering so many losses battling Asmodeus, she had to accept they needed all the help they could get.
Asmodeus and Leavemalone continued to fight at high speed. His two heads on the sides started casting spells. His frontal man-head uttered, "If you think you can face me with just speed alone, you are gravely mistaken, outworlder!"
The spells were completed. A lightning wall appeared behind Leavemealone, cutting his retreat path. On his left, lightning struck down from the sky. He was forced to move to the right.
"Got you!" Asmodeus shouted as he appeared next to Leavemealone. Leavemealone sensed the devil's approach, but in such a high-speed battle, sensing and reacting had a very short interval. This time, Leavemealone was not fast enough. Asmodeus' bird claw slammed into him.
He shot like a cannonball and crashed into the ground below.
"You didn't die from that blow. You are indeed not a typical outworlder," Asmodeus uttered. His large body dropped at high speed, attempting to stomp on Leavemealone. His serpent tail fired lightning bolts as he descended. Leavemealone shot away before Asmodeus crashed into the ground.
Leavemealone received damage from the earlier slap and the lightning bolts, but not severe. He had activated Battle Monk's Steel Body before the claw hit. Suzaki's flames also cushioned the blow, reducing the damage he received.
Asmodeus stared at Leavemealone without a word. While he expected this outworlder to not die from his slap and lightning bolts, he didn't expect his assaults to have so small an impact. He expected Leavemealone was still pinned in the ground to receive his stomping.
Leavemealone also didn't waste words. He advanced while activating Meditate. Supreme Fist improved this battle monk's skill. Leavemealone no longer had to stay static to use Meditate. He could use it while moving. If he didn't move, Meditate's effect was tripled. His lost HP was quickly refilled as the skill took effect.
Leavemealone roared as he used Supreme Fist's level 80 skill, Supreme Hundred Strikes. While Jack's hundred shadow strikes didn't live up to its name, this one did. Supreme Hundred Strikes truly conjured a hundred copies of Leavemealone as they rushed at Asmodeus.
These copies came from every direction. Asmodeus couldn't rely on his speed to evade. Instead, the devil erected three lightning shields around him. Each of his heads was considered a separate individual. They had their own set of spell libraries. All three had magic shields, so they could cast the same spell at the same time.
The lightning shields couldn't block all angles. Many copies landed hits, but each hit was retaliated by a strike of lightning. Lightning coursed through Asmodeus' body as the devil used Lightning Suit.
Asmodeus received damage from Leavemealone's Supreme Hundred Strikes, but nothing serious. His defense was already high, to begin with. After getting reinforced by the Lightning Suit, his defense rose even higher.
"I applaud you, outworlder!" Asmodeus exclaimed as the eyes on his three heads flared.
These six eyes shot dark purple lightning. They moved where Asmodeus stared at. Hence, they were very fast. Leavemealone tried his best to dodge, but one's body movements could never compete with an eye's movements. The chaos lightning rays finally caught up. Leavemealone used Ki Shield, a non-standard skill he had learned. The Ki Shield shattered from the impact. He was knocked back to the ground.
Asmodeus had also been casting a spell. Once Leavemealone fell back to the ground, he completed the spell. A lightning cage locked Leavemealone in. Asmodeus rushed forward.
Petunia used a bow skill with a knockback effect and cast a spell to hinder Asmodeus' charge, but the devil barreled through them. Asmodeus was determined to finish the outworlder this time.
Leavemealone was punching the lightning cage that confined him. His assault showed results but not fast enough. Asmodeus arrived before he could break out. He was about to use another of Supreme Fist's defensive skills to receive whatever attack Asmodeus was preparing, but an ice net appeared between him and Asmodeus.
Asmodeus slammed his claw into this ice net. The ice net was freezing cold. It tried to freeze Asmodeus' claw, but Asmodeus broke the net before it could freeze him. Though destroyed, the ice net halted Asmodeus for a breath.
During that time, something fast shot toward Asmodeus. It was a draconian. Asmodeus put up a claw to receive this draconian. The draconian drew a katana from its scabbard in one swift motion. The katana collided with the devil's giant claw. An explosive shockwave resulted from the impact. The draconian was thrown away, but Asmodeus was also forced to take three steps back.
By that time, the lightning cage had given in to Leavemealone's punches. Leavemealone jumped away and reunited with his two comrades, Arthur and Blackhole.
Arthur was the draconian who forced Asmodeus back. He combined mana-empowered Iaido with the Avenger's Raging Strike, which had a strong knockback force.
As for the ice net, it was a spell from Blackhole. The original spell he possessed was lightning net, but the passive ability of his pinnacle class, Ruler of Elementals, allowed him to convert the spells' elements between ice, lightning, and fire. He knew Asmodeus had a strong resistance against lightning, hence he changed the lightning net to an ice net. The ice element also had stronger endurance to stop an opponent compared to the other two elements.
Aside from giving a special ability to convert between the three elements, Ruler of Elementals' passive ability also enhanced all elemental damage produced by his spells and decreased all elemental damage he received. This ability was not limited to the three elements of fire, ice, and lightning, but to all elements except soul and chaos.
"You shouldn't have rushed here to face this devil alone, Haon. This fight is for all of us," Arthur reprimanded Haon.
"More outworlders…?" Asmodeus stared at the three. He was wondering how three outworlders way above the norm suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
As he had that thought, he sensed a strong incoming attack, but the attack was too close already. A fierce hurricane engulfed him.
The hurricane kept him grounded while multiple slashes hit his body. His lightning suit protected him. The lightning from the suit tried to strike back at the attacker, but the attacker moved too fast within the hurricane. The attacker was already gone by the time the lightning retaliation triggered.
The hurricane attack ended. An orc outworlder was revealed to be the one responsible.
"Your reign of terror is about to end, devil. We will vanquish you!" Four Winds declared.

chapters.title: Chapter 1907. Time to Get Serious
chapters.content:
Chapter 1907. Time to Get Serious
The hurricane Four Winds used to assault Asmodeus was a skill from his pinnacle class. It was King of Fury's level 50 skill, Tornado Cross.
He could get a jump at Asmodeus because he, too, had learned mana concealment. Four Winds always had good martial arts talent. If not for his being bogged down by having to attend to guild affairs, his advancement in martial arts would not be slower than Leavemealone.
He learned the basics when he was training inside Everlasting Heavenly Legends' Space-time Chamber. During that time, Domon and Wong were also in the chamber aside from his master, Murong. Leavemealone started learning mana concealment at the time, so Four Winds took the chance to request the same training as well. His expertise was still far from Jack's level, but it was enough to get him close to Asmodeus before the devil sensed his presence.
Asmodeus stared at this newcomer. He recognized this orc's voice. This orc was the one who had used the mana-empowered voice to make the absurd announcement. Now, he was making a declaration that was no less ridiculous.
"Vanquish me? Hehe… Interesting thought, but idiotic at the same time," Asmodeus mocked. "Are there any more of you, outworlders? If there are, I will wait for them. I've grown tired of those fools, anyway."
Petunia and Aneid gritted their teeth. It was no secret who Asmodeuss was referring to. Their pride was hurt. Yet, the reality was clear. They were indeed not Asmodeus' match. If not for these outworlders' interference, perhaps they would have joined Balrd's fate.
Four Winds turned to Aneid and Petunia.
"Aneid, you are a healer, aren't you? We will be relying on you," He said. He had used Inspect on the two before addressing them. "We have no healer, so your support will be appreciated. Petunia, you stay back and keep Aneid safe. We will handle this devil."
Petunia fumed. It hurt her pride to get ordered like this, but she calmed herself down. Pride had always been their core belief, but they also understood its flaws. Pride let them stand tall throughout all difficulties. But unchecked, it could be the very thing that brought them down.
She didn't confirm Four Winds' command but didn't show any defying gesture as well. Four Winds took that as them agreeing.
"Handle me?" Asmodeus snickered. "Every time you open your mouth, your words get more and more silly."
Four winds ignored Asmodeus. He told his three comrades, "Arthur, you are with me on the front line. Blackhole, you are in charge of damage dealing, but watch where you place your spells. Don't hit us. Haon… You do whatever you like."
Leavemealone harrumphed. The flaming wings behind him spread. He charged forward.
"I guess he will be on the front line as well," Arthur remarked.
"Hmph," Four Winds grunted. "We will attack from the sides different from him. Let's move!"
Arthur and Four Winds also charged forward.
"I take it that there are only the four of you," Asmodeus said.
Lightning Wings spread from his back. He shot up into the air before Leavemealone arrived. He then dropped back down abruptly at high speed. Leavemealone was taken aback by this move. He hurriedly jumped back. Asmodeus landed back on the ground with a loud thump. The ground caved in, and an earthquake spread outward.
Leavemealone flew up to avoid getting engulfed by the quaking earth. Four Winds and Arthur, who were halfway, did the same.
Asmodeus had started casting when he flew into the air. The spell was completed when he landed back on the ground. Countless lightning snakes spread in all directions.
Four Winds and the others recognized this spell. They had seen Jack cast it multiple times. The spell was the Perpetual Lightning Judgement. The lightning snakes were too fast. The three were unable to escape.
Four Winds used his bloodline's third skill, Titan Tenacity. His skin hardened and became like metal. This skill reduced all the damage he received by 80% for one minute. Leavemealone and Arthur also had defensive skills from their unique-grade bloodlines. They hurriedly activated the skills.
Before the lightning snakes hit, a change occurred in the environment. The lightning snakes hit the three. However, the damage they produced was less than what they should have inflicted. This was not only because of the bloodlines' defensive skills. It was also due to the condition of the environment.
The environmental condition came from Blackhole. Blackhole had cast Ruler of Elementals' level 80 spell, Elemental Domain. This spell created a domain that boosted all allies' elemental attacks. Whether they were skills or spells, the elemental damage was boosted. The domain also decreased all the elemental damage from hostile enemies.
Asmodeus frowned when he saw how ineffective his spell was. While he was pondering, different elemental energies assailed him. His frown turned deeper. He sensed these elemental energies didn't come from any of his opponents. It was as if the environment itself was assailing him.
While his sense was not wrong, the cause of the phenomenon was Blackhole. As long as the elemental domain was active, Blackhole could spend MP to trigger the elemental power within the domain to cause 100% random elemental damage to the enemies. The random elemental damage included the soul and chaos elements.
Four Winds and the others shot back toward Asmodeus when he was bothered by the elemental assaults. Leavemealone had the fastest speed, so he arrived before Asmodeus first. He was eager because he didn't want to waste his beast form. Unlike Jack's, his didn't last indefinitely. He intended to make full use of his beast form's power.
He activated another buff skill to strengthen himself. This buff skill was from Supreme Fist's level 90 skill, Supreme Reign. His entire body turned golden once the skill was active. Even the flames burning on his body also turned into golden flames. His stats skyrocketed. He used the Iron Punch.
Asmodeus was swinging his claw when he saw Leavemealone approaching. The claw and fist collided again. Before, Leavemealone was always the one thrown back from the impact. This time, the force threw them equally back.
Leavemealone's speed also increased significantly. He disappeared from where he was and was already next to Asmodeus an instant later. He sent a spin kick, which struck Asmodeus' sheep head. When Asmodeus tried to hit him using his claw, Leavemealone was gone again. Asmodeus then sensed a strong mana from below him.
He looked down and saw the image of a rising dragon. The dragon was roaring as he felt a strong impact on his chin. The blow was strong enough to lift even his giant body.
While Asmodeus' heavy body was lifted into the air from the Surging Dragon Punch, Leavemealone used Infinite Lightning Punches. Countless fiery explosions occurred on Asmodeus' chest as Leavemealone's fists struck like a rapid machine gun. Leavemealone ended the punch with Supreme Fist's level 50 skill, Supreme Punch.
Supreme Punch was a skill that delivered a single punch. The skill was simple, but it had two advantages. The first was its fast cooldown, which was only one minute at max level. The second was its damaging power, especially if the user landed a clean hit.
That was what happened right now. Leavemealone's fiery fist struck head-on on Asmodeus' belly. Damage number appeared. The damage was not higher than the one caused by Infinite Lightning Punches. However, this was just the start. If Supreme Punch landed, it had a follow-up effect.
The spot where Leavemealone punched started glowing. The glow intensified until it exploded. The explosion didn't happen just once but multiple times. Each explosion sent Asmodeus further back. Damage numbers continued to pop up from this explosion. Since this explosion occurred from the inside, Asmodeus' defense and lightning suit were useless against them. He suffered the full damage.
Asmodeus only stopped getting pushed back after the chained explosions ended. His three heads growled. He felt that punch. He felt like his inside was turning, which caused his reaction to slow.
Four Winds and Arthur arrived before him then. Both of them used their pinnacle classes' offensive skills.
Four Winds used Furious Cleave, King of Fury's level 80 skill. The skill dealt 2500% physical damage at max level. It also caused Bleed and had a high chance of wounding. The hit target got his defense reduced by 20% for the remainder of the battle. The defense reduction was not stackable. If Four Winds hit the same target again with this skill, the defense reduction would remain at 20%.
Arthur used Primordial Strike, Primordial Punisher's first skill. This skill dealt 1000% physical damage under normal conditions. But if the target had hit Arthur within the last hour, which Asmodeus did with his Perpetual Lightning Judgement, the damage increased to 1500%. Additionally, this skill had a high chance of causing Dizzy, Disoriented, and Cursed.
If Primordial Strike slew the target, which it currently did not, the slain target became an avenging spirit that followed Arthur around. This avenging spirit fought Arthur's enemies until it was killed or the combat ended.
The avenging orbs around Arthur were also different. They were larger and had a dark red shade. This was because of Primordial Punisher's passive ability. All the avenging orbs were now punishing orbs. Punishing orbs had double the effects of the avenging orbs. It also lasted longer at ten minutes, and a maximum of twenty orbs could be generated.
Asmodeus gritted his teeth as all these skills landed on him. These skills were unlike any those Council of Hybris' members threw at him. These skills had the capability to rattle him.
His bird claws and dragon claws gripped the ground hard. The ground cracked from the force. His three pairs of eyes shone with an ominous glow.
It was time to get serious.

chapters.title: Chapter 1908. Three Against Three
chapters.content:
Chapter 1908. Three Against Three
Asmodeus' man-head observed his body. His scales had visible cracks on them. He also felt his defenses weakened. His devil body could normally shorten any debuff significantly. He had been expecting these cracks to start mending themselves, but it didn't happen.
This was due to Four Wind's Furious Cleave. Asmodeus' defense was reduced by one-fifth until the combat was over.
"Never mind," He muttered.
He returned his attention to the three who continued to hit him. His bull and sheep heads had been casting spells to repel the three, but the three were persistent. He was also assailed continuously by the elemental energies from Blackhole's elemental domain.
When the three attacked again, all three heads of Asmodeus grinned. The three were bewildered by the grin. Before they could make sense of it, Asmodeus split into three.
Arthur suddenly found himself face-to-face with a dragon with a bull's head. Leavemealone dodged a charge from a creature with a bird's body but the head of a sheep.
As for Four Winds, he suddenly found himself coiled by a giant snake. Four Winds was the closest to Asmodeus. The snake had crazy explosive speed. Four Winds failed to react to the ambush.
The snake's one end was a normal snake's head, while its other end was the head of a man. The head with the man's face was staring down at Four Winds.
"Surprise?" Snake Asmodeus asked with a devilish grin.
Four Winds and the others weren't surprised by Asmodeus splitting into three because Wilted had informed them about this ability, but they were still surprised by how suddenly it happened. They expected there to be a process before it happened.
Snake Asmodeus' man-head started casting a spell while its snake-head shot lightning bolts at Blackhole. The spell was completed. It caused a blast of chaotic lightning to Petunia and Aneid, stunning and paralyzing them. All the while, the snake's body coiling around Four Winds was getting tighter. Four Winds received damage every second.
"Grrh…!" Four Winds tried exerting his strength. He even used his pinnacle class' level 60 skill, God's Fury. This skill gave him a buff that doubled the effect of max-level Berserk without its drawback. This skill lasted ten minutes. One thing special about this skill was that after it ended, Four Winds would still receive 25% of the skill's benefit for the remainder of the battle. It was not stackable, though.
However, even after receiving the buff, he still couldn't free himself. The snake budged when he used the skill, but it tightened its grip again soon. Four Winds' boosted strength was not enough.
*
On the other side, Arthur's katana clashed with dragon Asmodeus. Arthur had to take a step back every time his sword clashed with Asmodeus' claws.
The bull's horns started crackling with electricity. Arthur backflipped when he sensed an attack coming. A lightning blast was emitted from the horns. It struck the ground and chased after Arthur. Arthur was not fast enough to continue dodging the lightning, so he stopped running and slashed at the lightning.
A thick crescent light was created following his slash. It was his sword art, Crescent Moon Slash. The energy of the slash somehow halted Asmodeus' lightning for a second. It then shattered, and the lightning struck Arthur. Arthur was sent crashing into the ground while suffering the Paralyze effect.
"Stopping lightning with a slash? Are you kidding me?" Asmodeus mocked. He rushed ahead. His huge dragon claw attempted to stomp Arthur while the swordsman was paralyzed.
Arthur used Primordial Punisher's level 70 buff skill, Lethal Punisher, before the claw hit him. The skill healed 50% HP and removed all status afflictions upon activation. The heal recovered him from all the damage he suffered earlier. It also increased his stats and all the damage he inflicted. While the skill was active, 50% of the damage he suffered was reflected back to the attacker. This included the damage caused by range attacks. The skill also had a 10% chance to inflict Fear status on any enemy that struck him. Unfortunately, Asmodeus was immune to Fear.
Free from the paralyzation, Arthur rolled away before the stomp hit. He still received damage due to the quaking shockwave from the stomp. Half of this damage reflected back to Asmodeus.
Dragon Asmodeus was surprised his prey could escape. Arthur made use of the surprise by dashing ahead and landing a hit on the devil. The hit was done using Primordial Punisher's level 60 skill, Punishing Oath. This skill was a short-burst offense that marked an enemy. Upon successful hit, all damage from Arthur against the target improved by 1% every minute, until a maximum of 100%. This mark lasted the entire battle.
This skill shone when used in a long battle. In less than two hours, every hit from Arthur would result in double damage.
Arthur kept up the pressure by using Shadowless Slash. Dragon Asmodeus couldn't keep up with the fast slashes. He tanked them and used brute force by shoving his claw through the net of swordlights. Arthur stopped his offense and parried the claw using his sword.
Arthur still couldn't contest Dragon Asmodeus' strength despite his buff. He was thrown by the impact. When he finally regained his balance, he found a lightning cage had been erected around him.
This lightning cage was cast by Dragon Asmodeus. It was the same spell that trapped Leavemealone earlier, but that spell was cast by Asmodeus' other head. Arthur slashed the lightning cage, but it was very sturdy. He was even electrocuted every time his sword hit the cage.
Dragon Asmodeus cast another spell while Arthur tried to free himself. A long dark purple lance materialized from the completed spell formation. This chaos lance had multiple sparks of lightning coursing around it.
"Let's see how you survive this spell," Dragon Asmodeus uttered with a mocking laugh.
*
While Snake Asmodeus had the highest burst speed, Bird Asmodeus had the highest maintained speed. He was faster than Chimeral Asmodeus. His speed was even slightly faster than Leavemealone under the effect of Supreme Reign. Leavemealone had to rely on his fast reflex and precise reaction to block Bird Asmodeus' every attack.
The two fought at high speed, moving all around the battlefield. Both on the ground and in the air. They caused loud shockwaves every time they clashed.
Their battle seemed like a tie. That was until Leavemealone lost his white tiger emperor form. His stats dropped significantly. He could no longer compete with Bird Asmodeus in terms of speed. Bird Asmodeus' claw struck him from behind and sent him crashing into the ground.
Bird Asmodeus' sheep head cast a spell upon the successful hit. Multiple lightning spears rained where Leavemealone had fallen.
Leavemealone blocked the lightning spears using Ki Shield empowered by mana manipulation. The supreme reign also buffed his defense while Suzaki's flames reduced the damage he received. This allowed him to survive the strike and the lightning spears. He countered the received damage by using meditation to recover his HP while defending.
Seeing his prey was not giving up, Bird Asmodeus resumed a melee approach. He zoomed to Leavemealone. His claw struck the Ki Shield and shattered it. When he was about to land a follow-up strike, he noticed a strange scene on his opponent. Several blurry afterimages were around Leavemealone. The outworlder himself was not moving.
Bird Asmodeus didn't think too much about it. He went along with the strike. However, when his bird claw struck Leavemealone, he didn't feel like he had struck anything. Leavemealone's blurry afterimages exploded in all directions. Bird Asmodeus' mana sense couldn't detect which was the real Leavemealone among these afterimages.
While he was confused, he felt an impact on his side. Leavemealone punched him using Supreme Punch again. He felt his inside explode as he skidded several steps away.
What Leavemealone had used to dodge was Supreme Fist's level 70 skill, Supreme Stance. It was a defensive skill that fooled an attacking enemy. Leavemealone was impossible to hit when this skill was active. The best thing an opponent could do when Leavemealone used this skill was to stop attacking and wait until the skill was over. Because if they did, they would most likely receive a counterattack.
Whether it was a melee or ranged attack, Leavemealone would zoom toward the attacker while the attacker was confused by his afterimages. All the afterimages had Leavemealone's mana signature so it could fool enemies with mana sense. Leavemealone combined it with his mana concealment, further guaranteeing the enemy couldn't detect where he would attack from.
Additionally, a counterattack performed after dodging an attack using this skill was guaranteed to always be critical.
Same as before, Bird Asmodeus was stunned by the Supreme Punch. Leavemealone didn't waste the chance. He used Ki Blast. The energy ball he formed was enshrouded by golden flames. The ball became much bigger than it was. He unleashed this golden flaming ball before Bird Asmodeus recovered from the stun.
The golden flaming ball struck Bird Asmodeus, and a fiery explosion occurred.
When the explosion subsided, Leavemealone sensed a sudden spike of mana. A chaos lightning lance shot out, which he dodged. He heaved a relieved sigh. From the mana, he knew he wouldn't be unscathed if this lance hit. But before his sigh was over, a lightning bolt shot out. This lightning bolt transformed into Bird Asmodeus right in front of him. Bird Asmodeus' claw struck his waist before he could react.
The strike threw him to the ground. Bird Asmodeus stepped one foot on him while his other foot kicked him repeatedly.
"Die! Die…!! Hahaha!" Bird Asmodeus laughed like a lunatic while kicking endlessly. Damage numbers continued to pop up from Leavemealone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1909. Saving Four Winds
chapters.content:
1909  Chapter 1909. Saving Four Winds
Four Winds continued to lose HP as Snake Asmodeus tightened the grip. Four Winds couldn't do anything because he couldn't move. The snake's body coiling around him left no space. It became tighter by the second. Snake Asmodeus also had the lightning suit on. Four Winds continued to get assailed by lightning and got paralyzed continuously.
Blackhole cast spells to force Snake Asmodeus to let go of Four Winds. Petunia did the same, but the devil ignored their attacks. Snake Asmodeus erected a lightning shield to block most of their attacks. Runic symbols adorned the lightning shield, reinforcing it.
The offensive spells from Blackhole's pinnacle class were all AOE spells, so he refrained from using them. Otherwise, Four Winds might end up getting killed by him instead of Asmodeus. He had several non-standard spells in possession, but none could help in this situation.
"Do you have something that can stagger the devil?" Blackhole asked Petunia.
Petunia used her wand to cast defensive spells to block the lightning bolts fired by Snake Asmodeus' snake head. She could only attack using her bowgun.
"I have a bow skill with strong stunning ability," Petunia answered. "It works on Asmodeus because I've used it on him before. It is a golden opportunity to use this skill since he is not moving, but that shield is in the way. I plan to use it once we destroy that lightning shield."
"That shield doesn't seem to be expiring anytime soon. I will move that shield out of the way. Use your skill on my mark."
"All right," Petunia nodded.
Snake Asmodeus' human head didn't have his attention on them. He simply had his lightning shield facing their direction and the snake head firing lightning bolts at them. The human head was observing Four Winds, who was in his grip. He was surprised the outworlder lasted this long. Even a native with a large HP pool would have perished if one was in his clutch for so long.
Although Four Winds had high defense and HP due to his max-level armor and max bloodline, he would still have perished if he was still using his old class. He could last this long because of King of Fury's passive abilities.
His HP would automatically refill to full when it fell below 50% for the first time. The next time his HP fell to 25%, it would refill to 70%. After that, if it dropped to 10%, it would rise back to 50%. This automatic instant HP recovery had a cooldown of twenty-four hours. He had currently used up the second refill. He only left the last one when his HP fell to 10%.
Aside from that, King of Fury also gave a bonus of 5000 HP to his max HP. The class also negated the instant kill effect, with a cooldown of twenty-four hours as well. Among the pinnacle classes that branched from the warrior class, King of Fury boasted the highest survivability.
Yet, this survivability couldn't help him. His strength was not enough to wrestle himself out of Snake Asmodeus' clasp. He was powerless in this situation. He was about to use Devilize when he received Blackhole's message.
Blackhole cast one of his non-standard spells, Lightning Lasso. Under normal circumstances, Lightning Lasso wouldn't affect the lightning shield. Luckily, Blackhole could convert his spells between the three elements. He converted the Lightning Lasso into the Ice Lasso.
The Lightning Shield was encased in ice when the Ice Lasso coiled around it. Blackhole then pulled. He couldn't move the lightning shield the entire way out, but he managed to shift its position and kept it from moving back.
"Now!" He shouted.
Petunia had been aiming her bowgun. She fired once Blackhole gave the signal. The bolt from her shot created a spiraling vortex of energy. The name of this shot was Ultra Vanity Shot. It was a bow skill that was only available in their faction.
The spiraling energy following the bolt increased in speed as the bolt advanced. The light at the tip of the bolt also turned brighter. Snake Asmodeus sensed the bolt's power too late. The bolt pierced into him.
Petunia didn't lie. The shot did affect Asmodeus. He was stunned. Furthermore, the lightning shield, which was still frozen, fizzled out. Magic Shield was a maintained spell. If the caster stopped maintaining it, the spell ended. This indicated Petunia's shot not only stunned Asmodeus' body but also his mind.
Four Winds took action then. He had been readying himself since Blackhole messaged him. When he felt Snake Asmodeus stop pressing his body, he used Cry of Rage to make himself immune to the paralyzing effect of Asmodeus' lightning suit. He then used his bloodline's skill, Titan Strength. The skill not only increased his strength but also his body mass.
The increase of Four Winds' body mass was system-generated. Even if Snake Asmodeus still applied pressure, he would still get pushed out to give space for Four Winds' body to enlarge. Four Winds canceled Titan Strength as soon as his body reached its largest limit. His body instantly shrunk again.
If Snake Asmodeus was not stunned, his coiling would squeeze back following the shrinking of Four Winds' body. But since he did, he stayed in the position following Four Winds' giant body size. Four Winds shrunk body was now in a cavity formed by Snake Asmodeus' coiling body. Four Winds quickly spread his wings and flew out through the gap between Snake Asmodeus' lengthy body.
Seeing Four Winds successfully escape, Blackhole unleashed his other non-standard spell. This spell was originally also of the lightning element. It was called Lightning Paralyzing Beam. It was a high-damage single-target offensive spell with a high chance of inflicting Paralyze. But since Asmodeus had high resistance to lightning and he had the lightning suit on, Blackhole changed the element into ice.
The spell that came out was a beam of freezing ice. While it had an unusually high chance of inflicting Paralyze in its original form, its modified form gave it a high chance of causing Freeze. The beam slammed into Snake Asmodeus, who had just come out of his stun condition. A layer of solid ice started covering his body while he suffered ice damage.
Yet, as soon as the freezing effect took effect, cracks also appeared on the ice layer. Dark purple lightning pierced out from the cracks. The ice layer shattered with a boom, revealing Snake Asmodeus, who was covered in a coat of dark purple lightning. His eyes stared sharply at Blackhole.
"Since you wish it, let's change the arrangement. You will die first," Snake Asmodeus uttered with a threatening tone.
The chaos lightning around him converged into a spot before it became a ray that shot forward.
"Don't underestimate me, devil!" Blackhole exclaimed. He cast the Ruler of Elemental level 60 spell, Elemental Superiority.
Elemental Superiority was a defensive spell. At max level, the spell lasted ten seconds. During this time, Blackhole was immune to all elemental damage. Furthermore, all elemental attacks hitting him were channeled into an elemental orb.
Snake Asmodeus was startled his prey survived one of his top skills, the Chaos Lightning Annihilating Ray. Blackhole didn't waste the chance when Snake Asmodeus was shocked. The gathered elemental orb was fired toward the devil.
Snake Asmodeus only came out of his shock when the elemental orb was already before him. He didn't have time to cast high-level defensive spells. He hastily erected the lightning shield again. The lightning shield blocked the elemental orb while runic symbols flashed around the shield.
Blackhole's elemental orb contained the power of Asmodeus' Chaos Lightning Annihilating Ray. A meager magic shield, even when boosted by the runic defensive technique, was not enough. The lightning shield didn't fizzle like the last time. It was destroyed. Snake Asmodeus wouldn't be able to conjure the shield again for some time.
Following the lightning shield's destruction, the elemental orb exploded in a cacophony of chaos and lightning elements. These elements assailed Snake Asmodeus. The lightning element couldn't hurt him much, but the chaos element was another matter. Damage numbers came up repeatedly above him while heavy pressure weighed him down.
Blackhole followed up by casting Ruler of Elemental's level 70 spell, Elemental Lockdown. A dome of turbulent elemental energies covered Snake Asmodeus. These elemental energies assailed him while dealing damage. The pressure he experienced multiplied a great deal. Even he had trouble moving under the pressure.
Four Winds didn't waste this chance. He used the two remaining skills from his pinnacle class.
The first was King of Fury's level 70 skill, Voice of Fury. He uttered a thundering war cry with the skill. It dealt damage to all hostiles within his surroundings and applied debuff for one hour. As for the allies within range, they received a buff for the remainder of the battle. This buff was not stackable.
He applied mana manipulation to the skill, which empowered its range. His voice reached Leavemealone and Arthur, who fought not far away. His skill buffed them as well as debuffing the other two Asmodeus.
His other skill was King of Fury's level 90 skill, Axe of the God. It was an offensive skill that dealt massive damage. Now that Snake Asmodeus' movement was locked down, this skill was a sure hit.
A loud gong sounded from the sky. As it did, the clouds parted, and an impossibly large axe came down. The appearance of this celestial axe shocked everyone. Many combatants on the battlefield, whether the defenders or the demons, paused their fight to look at this descending axe.
They wondered which God dropped this axe onto this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1910. Down to Three
chapters.content:
1910  Chapter 1910. Down to Three
Everyone watched the Godly axe fall. Those who realized they were in the area where the axe fell immediately ran away. Although the axe was humongous, one only needed to flee to the side. The axe's area of impact was a long but narrow line, so it was not difficult to evade. Snake Asmodeus, however, could not because his movement was under lockdown.
He saw the incoming axe. Even he didn't dare to underestimate it. He couldn't move, but he could still cast a spell. A swirling chaotic energy appeared above him. Lightning gathered at the center of these swirling energies. The lightning spread until it formed a gigantic buckler.
The Godly axe arrived then. It crashed into the giant lightning buckler. The lightning buckler shattered at first impact. This took Snake Asmodeus aback. He didn't expect his defensive spell to not halt the axe even for an instant. The axe fell on him then.
The touchdown caused the earth to quake. The tremor was felt throughout the entire battlefield. Dust clouds spread from the point of impact.
Both Dragon Asmodeus and Bird Asmodeus were not in the area where the axe fell, but they, too, looked over when this massive axe hit. They were originally one body with Snake Asmodeus, so they could sense his condition. Though he was still alive, he was not unscathed.
When the dust clouds settled, a long gorge was seen along the land. The Godly axe had carved a deep wound on the earth. Snake Asmodeus was nowhere to be seen.
*
Dragon Asmodeus was preparing to throw the Chaos Lightning Lance at Arthur. He wanted to savor his opponent's terrified expression for being helpless inside his lightning cage. However, he saw no such expression from the outworlder.
Arthur instead closed his eyes while putting his katana back on its sheath. His face was calm. This confused the devil.
'Did he give up?' Dragon Asmodeus wondered. He preferred his opponents to break down in fear, not accepting their fate calmly like this.
"Hmph! Never mind," Dragon Asmodeus harrumphed. He threw the chaos lightning lance in his hand. The lance caused a thundering sound when it was released. Lightning sparks formed its trail.
Arthur's calm expression never changed. His breathing was even slower than normal. He was as serene as still water. When the lance was halfway, he finally opened his eyes. The hand on his katana hilt became a blur.
His katana went lightning-fast. A straight long line swept past the lightning that formed his cage. The combination of his sword's heart, master-level mana manipulation, and One-word Slash cut through the cage where its lightning links were the weakest. When the katana stopped, everyone could see the katana had transformed. Arthur had activated Demonize Weapon when he used Iaido. He also combined his slash with his weapon's offensive skill. The lightning cage unraveled from the slash.
The offensive skill from his Fallen Apostle's Katana was Demon God's Slash. It was a powerful single-attack skill that hit from a range. A crimson crescent formed from Arthur's swing, and it flew ahead to meet the chaos lightning lance.
Dragon Asmodeus was surprised the outworlder managed to destroy his lightning cage. However, he was confident of his chaos lightning lance. He was sure his spell would destroy the crimson crescent and strike Arthur. Arthur remained in the end motion after performing his skill. There was not enough time for Arthur to do evasive maneuvers.
Dragon Asmodeus considered his chaos lightning spell would lose some power after clashing with the crimson crescent. Arthur might survive. So, he prepared to cast another spell for a follow-up attack.
The distance between the chaos lightning lance and the crimson crescent was shortening. Then, they passed one another. The two energies grazed one another when they passed, but no collision happened.
Dragon Asmodeus was taken aback. Did the outworlder miss? He didn't mind. This just meant his chaos lightning lance would hit with full force. However, he would also be hit by the crimson crescent. The crescent was already upon him. There was not enough time to dodge. He stopped casting and swung his claw to meet the crimson crescent.
For a sword practitioner with Sword's Heart, it was almost impossible for Arthur to miss, and he didn't. His target was always Dragon Asmodeus, not the Chaos Lightning Lance.
The crimson crescent clashed with Dragon Asmodeus' claw. Dragon Asmodeus was shocked to find his claw recoiled from the impact. The power from the crimson crescent was more than he expected. The crimson crescent cut into him and left a long wound. The hard scales protecting his body cracked. Blood spurted from the wound.
While Dragon Asmodeus couldn't dodge, neither could Arthur. He sacrificed himself to land that hit on the devil. Although he sacrificed himself, he did not sacrifice his life. Avenger's final retribution kicked in when the chaos lance stabbed into him. His HP stopped dropping at 1, and he became invulnerable for a few seconds. All the punishing orbs around him turned into soul bombs and shot toward Dragon Asmodeus.
Dragon Asmodeus was still stunned by the wound he received from the crimson crescent. He failed to react when the soul bombs crashed into him. Chained explosions occurred all over his body, causing damage with each explosion.
Arthur didn't let up. He charged forward while drinking the Ultimate Healing Potion. He then used Primordial Punisher's level 90 skill, Primordial Punishment. The skill dealt 2000% physical damage to a single target under a normal situation, but the damage increased to 3000% if the target had hit Arthur within the last hour. This skill also dealt splash damage to nearby enemies. But since there were none, this effect didn't take place.
11:33
Arthur didn't let up. He charged forward while drinking the Ultimate Healing Potion. He then used Primordial Punisher's level 90 skill, Primordial Punishment. The skill dealt 2000% physical damage to a single target under a normal situation, but the damage increased to 3000% if the target had hit Arthur within the last hour. This skill also dealt splash damage to nearby enemies. But since there were none, this effect didn't take place.
The damage inflicted by this skill ignored 50% of the target's defense. It also had a high chance of stunning and wounding the opponent. Additionally, Arthur received a boost to his stats and damage for one minute after he executed Primordial Punishment.
Another gash appeared after Arthur landed the Primordial Punishment. Dragon Asmodeus was in stunned condition, both from the mental shock and the Primordial Punishment's effect. Arthur didn't let this chance go. His katana turned into a blur as he executed Shadowless Slash. Countless swordlights crisscrossed all over Dragon Asmodeus' body.
Arthur jumped away the second he sensed his opponent's mana returned to normal, which was correct because Dragon Asmodeus was about to retaliate.
Dragon Asmodeus watched his opponent with a gaze that was different than before. He lost quite a lot of HP from the exchange just now. He no longer underestimated Arthur. Arthur's action was extremely precise.
"Not bad, outworlder," Dragon Asmodeus praised.
At that time, Four Winds' Axe of the God descended from heaven. Dragon Asmodeus glanced at the heavenly axe before turning his attention in another direction. He then spoke, "You, your ethereal comrade, and your orc comrade aren't half bad. The same can't be said about your vampire comrade. The four of you are now down to three."
Arthur glanced to where Leavemealone was after hearing that. What he saw was Leavemealone lying on the ground with zero HP.
*
Several minutes before that, Leavemealone was still pinned on the ground while Bird Asmodeus kicked him relentlessly. Suzaki's flames cushioned the blows. His Supreme Reign was also active. Still, he couldn't just take this beating and did nothing.
He used Supreme Fist's level 60 skill, Supreme Ki Armor. A second layer of armor made of pure energy covered his body. This ki armor further enhanced his defense and reduced the damage he received. It also improved the recovery effect from Meditation.
He endured the pounding while measuring Bird Asmodeus' kicking rhythm. Once he got used to it, he threw an Iron Punch right when Bird Asmodeus' foot was coming down.
When the punch and kick collided, he also used Ki Outburst. The energy outburst radiated out from him was reinforced with strong flames. The combined punch and energy outburst caused Bird Asmodeus to lose his balance. The foot that was pinning Leavemealone shifted. With the pressure weakening, Leavemealone punched that foot with his other fist and freed himself. He rolled away before Bird Asmodeus could pin him down again.
"Don't think you can run from me!" Bird Asmodeus exclaimed.
With only Supreme Reign, Leavemealone couldn't compete with Bird Asmodeus' speed. The devil ran around him while sending lightning-fast kicks. Bird Asmodeus also cast spells while doing that. Multiple spells hit him as he tried his best to either parry or dodge Bird Asmodeus' kicks. He found no opportunity to counterattack.
'Calm down!' He told himself. Even with the defensive buffs, he was still losing HP. Meditate couldn't keep up with the damage he suffered. His HP bar was now below thirty percent. This was not much for an outworlder without beast form. Any common combatant would have panicked by now, but Leavemealone knew it was at this critical moment that one needed to remain calm.
He was again studying Bird Asmodeus' attack patterns. Despite being extremely fast, Bird Asmodeus did the same thing again and again. This let Leavemealone grasp the timing of his next kick. He used Cycle of Shade and Shadow right before the kick landed.
Bird Asmodeus suddenly found himself out of balance while Leavemealone shifted behind him. Leavemealone landed a Supreme Punch on his back. The impact sent him reeling several meters away.
Leavemealone was just about to continue his assault, but he sensed dangers from his surroundings.
Bird Asmodeus looked back with a grinning face. "Hehe. You are done for," he laughed.
One of the spells Bird Asmodeus cast earlier was Lightning Mine. Five lightning orbs were placed around Leavemealone. Bird Asmodeus' lightning mine was not the standard one. His mines discharged dark purple lightning.
When the orbs started discharging chaos lightning, Leavemealone took the only way out, which was up. However, Bird Asmodeus was already there waiting for him.
"Like I said, you are done for!" The devil exclaimed and kicked him hard.
Leavemealone crashed back into the ground, where chaos lightning stung his body. It didn't take long before his HP dropped to zero.

chapters.title: Chapter 1911. Last Stand
chapters.content:
1911  Chapter 1911. Last Stand
Bird Asmodeus stood over Leavemealone's body with a condescending expression.
"That's what happens when a weakling attempts to fight someone out of their league," Bird Asmodeus mocked. He turned his attention to the other side. Four Winds' Axe of the God had just fallen over Snake Asmodeus. Dragon Asmodeus was wounded by Arthur.
The injury suffered by his two halves wasn't severe, but it was embarrassing. How could they let outworlders push them to such an extent?
He was still thinking about whether to help Dragon Asmodeus or Snake Asmodeus when he sensed hot mana from behind him. He turned around and was astonished to find a raging flame burning from the outworlder he had just killed.
His astonishment turned to alarm when he realized this flame was sentient. A loud shriek sounded from inside the flame. A spell formation formed above the flame following the shriek.
Multiple fireballs emerged from the completed spell formation. Bird Asmodeus moved out of reflex, evading the fireballs about to hit him. These fireballs turned and chased after him.
"Flame Wrath?" Asmodeus identified the spell. He cast Dispel while retreating. The fireballs evaporated out of existence.
When he returned his attention to the flame that cast Flame Wrath, he found the flame had grown wings. Another shriek and the flame converged into a more distinctive shape. A giant firebird!
"What is this trick? A spell?" Bird Asmodeus asked.
Arthur, who was a distance away, recognized the firebird. It was Suzaki. 'Was she freed after Leavemealone lost his life?' He thought with worry.
Suzaki remained still after revealing herself. Bird Asmodeus didn't. Whoever the opponent was, he would tear them to pieces. He cast a spell that conjured multiple lightning arrows before turning into a lightning bolt himself and zooming forward.
Suzaki's burning eyes flared once Bird Asmodeus delivered his attacks. She spread her wings, releasing many fire darts. These fire darts intercepted the lightning arrows. The air was filled with explosions as the lightning arrows and fire darts collided.
Bird Asmodeus in lightning form moved in a zig-zag pattern, evading those explosions. The lightning turned back into Bird Asmodeus once it got near Suzaki. A flame shield appeared as Bird Asmodeus delivered a kick. The kick destroyed the flame shield, but Suzaki was no longer there. She shot up into the sky.
"Don't think you can run," Bird Asmodeus uttered. His lightning wings spread, and he shot into the sky as well.
Bird Asmodeus was faster than Suzaki. It didn't take long for him to catch up to the firebird. Suzaki used her wings to cover herself and turned into a fireball before Bird Asmodeus arrived. This fireball then rushed at the incoming devil.
Bird Asmodeus wasn't flustered. His leg went up and kicked the fireball. The fireball bounced from the impact. He then chased after it.
Suzaki in fireball form was faster than her normal speed. Her current speed almost rivaled Bird Asmodeus' speed. The two went around at high speed and crashed repeatedly in the air.
"Do you think you can match my speed? Think again!" Bird Asmodeus exclaimed. He again transformed into lightning when Fireball Suzaki almost crashed into him. His lightning form made a sharp turn and he was now behind Suzaki.
He kicked Suzaki from behind, and the fireball crashed into the ground. Bird Asmodeus cast a lightning strike to pin Suzaki on the ground while he zoomed there.
Suzaki had returned to her normal form, but she wasn't helpless. Fierce flames burst out of her when Bird Asmodeus arrived. Bird Asmodeus was damaged by this flame outburst. These flames were intense enough that Bird Asmodeus stopped approaching and took a step back.
These flames condensed into a thick fire beam that aimed at Bird Asmodeus. Bird Asmodeus was too close to do evasive maneuvers. He erected a lightning shield. Multiple runic symbols revolved around the lightning shield, reinforcing it.
The fire beam crashed into the lightning shield. It held for a while, but eventually, the runic symbols melted. The lightning shield shattered with a bang. The fire beam lost its power after destroying the lightning shield, but Bird Asmodeus still received damage from the explosion.
After performing the Giga Flame Burst, Suzaki shrunk.
"I won't be able to do this again for some time," she said. "Don't die again."
She shrunk until her flames formed a normal human shape. The flames diminished in intensity, and Leavemealone was seen inside the flames. His HP was back to full.
"If you let me die, there is a chance you might gain freedom or die with me. Aren't both those outcomes preferable for you?" Leavemealone asked.
"… It's not a certainty," Suzaki answered. "I can only grant you the flame rebirth once in this battle. Don't expect me to do it again."
"I understand. I have no intention of dying again," Leavemealone said before adding, "Thank you, Suzaki."
Suzaki didn't respond to the gratitude.
"You…," Bird Asmodeus was surprised that Leavemealone was still alive. "What kind of trickery did you use…? Never mind. I will just kill you again."
Leavemealone clenched his fist. "Do not expect it to happen twice, devil!" Leavemealone proclaimed.
Although Suzaki let Leavemealone take over, she didn't recede completely. While Leavemealone had used her flames before, it was different this time. Suzaki was actively supporting him. Leavemealone was as if wearing a suit of bird costume made of flames. Suzaki's head rested atop Leavemealone's head as if a helmet.
Transformation also occurred in Leavemealone's body. Demonic features developed as he used Devilize.
Leavemealone took a stance. "Come at me, devil!" He exclaimed.
*
When Leavemealone dropped to the ground with zero HP, Four Winds was staring down the gorge his Axe of the God had created.
"Your skill couldn't have killed him, could it?" Blackhole asked.
"I don't think so. The devils are immune to instant kill, even if they receive a grave wound," Four Winds said. He turned to observe the other two Asmodeus. "Wilted said the three will recombine once they lost a certain amount of HP."
Four winds noticed Leavemealone, who died when he was looking at the two Asmodeus. He was considering engaging Bird Asmodeus when he heard a scream from behind. He and Blackhole turned and saw that Snake Asmodeus had shown up. Petunia was shooting at the devil with her gunbow while Aneid was half inside the mouth of Snake Asmodeus' snake head.
After getting hit by the Axe of the God, Snake Asmodeus hid within the gorge. He bid his time and stayed out of everyone's mana sense range. He slithered to where Petunia and Aneid were. Though he didn't want to, he must admit the four outworlders were not easy opponents. He decided to take out the weakest and the source of their healing. With his explosive speed, he struck when everyone was unaware.
"Release her! You, devil!" Petunia shouted. She never stopped shooting her gunbow while her left hand continued to cast offensive spells, but Snake Asmodeus ignored all that.
Less and less of Aneid was seen as Snake Asmodeus gobbled the poor healer. Four Winds and Blackhole rushed over to help, but Snake Asmodeus' man head had prepared a spell. Lightning Storm was cast. The large area offensive spell assailed the two and halted their advance.
When Aneid fully entered Snake Asmodeus' stomach, a large recovery number appeared above him. Four Winds' Axe of the God had left a long wide scar along Snake Asmodeus' body. This scar narrowed after Snake Asmodeus consumed his prey. Although the wound was not fully healed, it was mending.
"Tch!" Four Winds didn't expect the devil to resort to such a covert tactic and ambush them. He had been careless.
Snake Asmodeus' man-head grinned at them. It was not a condescending grin like before, but a savage one. "I'm done playing games with you, people."
After speaking, he let out a high-pitched shriek. A commotion was heard from the demons all around the battlefield.
"He is calling for his demon minions to come here!" Blackhole exclaimed. He saw the nearest demons ignored the defenders and rushed in their direction.
"Damn it!" Four winds cursed. He expected this devil to have the arrogance to continue taking them on by himself. It apparently was not so.
Blackhole cast his AOE offensive spells at the incoming wave of demons. Two of these spells came from his pinnacle class. The first was Ruler of Elemental's beginning spell, Elemental Tempest. It was a more powerful version of Elemental Storm that dealt every elemental damage except for chaos and soul.
The second was Ruler of Elemental's level 90 spell, Elemental Armageddon. When this spell was cast, it was as if an Armageddon had occurred. Lightning rained from the sky, the earth quaked, fire burst out of the cracked earth, and multiple hurricanes formed followed by a hail of ice. This spell covered an extremely large area, but the great thing about this spell was the elements assailed only the enemies. The elements left allies alone unless they intentionally stepped into where the elementals were raging.
Arthur also adjusted his position and unleashed Primordial Punisher's level 80 skill, Punishing Devastation. This was also an AOE offensive skill. His skill hit both Dragon Asmodeus and the demons coming to the devil's aid.
More and more demons came. Several high demons came from the air and were prepared to cast their spells at Four Winds and the others, but a strong beam of lightning hit them out of the air.
A thundering roar followed. Quetzalcoatl arrived and released countless lightning that assailed the demons in the air.
On the ground, many orc soldiers came rushing and intercepted the demons who came to Asmodeus' aid.
"Sorry, it takes some time to reorganize the army," Water Lily sent Four Winds a message. "I have sent over most of the defending soldiers on the wall. I will also leave this war table behind and go over there to fight. As you said, there will be no more retreating. This is our last stand. We will focus on the demons around you. Please take care of Asmodeus as fast as possible."
"Thank you," Four Winds replied. "We will win this war. You mark my words!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1912. Better Special Class
chapters.content:
Chapter 1912. Better Special Class
Grace, Red Death, Nameless, and Badass came out behind the defensive walls of Sangrod Front.
The battle at this front had started five days ago. The scattered Sangrod soldiers had regrouped under the banner of the new emperor, Arlcard Maxius. Newly trained recruits had also gathered here, so their number was more than the defeated army who fled the Palgrost Northern Front.
When the Sangrod army regrouped at the defensive line of Sangrod, Sangrod's native adventurers, Sangrod's players, and the nagas also came. They were glad they had a place to focus their resistance again, though they didn't feel optimistic about it.
They were also unsure about their new leader. They had never heard of Arlcard. All they had heard was he was of the Maxius blood and assumed the throne since he was the only Maxius left. However, when the battle started, they were surprised that Arlcard was the first to charge at the demons.
Arlcard fought at the forefront, fighting together with his army. He left the army arrangement to Darius Armand, using the newly constructed war table Arlcard brought from Vacharest.
The Sangrod soldiers were inspired by their new emperor's bravery and ferocity. They threw away all worries and fought with conviction. The native adventurers, players, and the nagas followed suit.
Grace and the others flew toward the wall battlements. They aided the defenders in defending the walls while observing the battlefield beyond the walls.
The walls were mostly still intact even after five days of battle. The siege weapons on and behind the walls were also mostly in good condition. This was because of four factors.
The first was the defenders' morale was higher than the other fronts. They spent longer days without battles compared to other fronts when they fled Palgrost. This allowed them a long rest. The Sangrod soldiers were also now defending their home country.
The second was the reduction in underworld forces' reinforcement, courtesy of Master's meddling. Because of this, the demons' number wasn't as overwhelming as it used to be.
The third was Arlcard's heroic display. Arlcard didn't do anything different than in the previous battles before he became the emperor. But now that he was Sangrod's emperor, his every move was scrutinized. Under normal situations, this only served to irritate the vampire. But during the current situation, this instead inspired the soldiers to look up to him.
The previous emperor always stayed behind and commanded the army from a safer position. There was nothing wrong with that. It could even be said that this was the norm. However, there was a sense of pride and admiration when your leader was out there with you, risking his life together with you.
This, of course, also put Arlcard in the crosshairs more often than Horatio. However, Arlcard wasn't an easy target. He had increased another level during the battle and was now a level 92 eternal vampire. He could stand his ground against the strongest combatant from the underworld forces, as long as said combatant was not a devil.
Additionally, after losing their previous emperor, Darius was more vigilant in protecting Arlcard. He was not going to fail in protecting two emperors in a row.
