"Sataannn...!!!"
Eoranth stayed up there in the sky after being punched by Satan. He turned out to be gathering mana for his Annihilating Soul Beam. Rings filled with runic symbols appeared when he fired the accumulated energy in his mouth.
Satan grinned at the sight. His right hand resummoned the Soul and Chaos Ring of Defense while his left cast a spell. He aimed his left hand down when the spell was cast.
Honuren, who was struggling to get up, felt an invisible power gripping his body. He was then yanked into the sky.
Grace was healing Eoranth earlier while he was gathering mana. When she saw Honuren getting thrown into the ground, she headed there to heal him. She was just about to reach him when he was suddenly pulled away.
The one responsible was Satan, using Extreme Telekinesis. Honuren was pulled toward Satan as Eoranth's Annihilating Soul Beam was on its way down. Honuren was helpless against the spell. Satan placed Honuren between himself and the incoming spell. He then put his Soul and Chaos Ring of Defense behind Honuren.
When the Annihilating Soul Beam arrived, it crashed into the ring of defense. Honuren was sandwiched between the two great powers. The pressure he suffered was unbearable. He let out a pained howl as his body got battered by the destructive beam.
The mighty silver beam lasted for some time. When it finally ended, Satan was still floating where he was. He didn't move an inch, and he didn't receive any damage. The Soul and Chaos Ring of Defense showed no new cracks. This proved the Celestial Shine was more damaging than the Annihilating Soul Beam.
Honuren fell after the force pinning him was gone. He didn't move as he fell. Jeanny, who had flown back to rejoin the fight, paused when she saw the sight.
"No...," she uttered. Honuren's HP bar was zero.
The lifeless body fell to the ground. Jeanny looked away. There would be the time to grieve. Now, she didn't have the luxury. She flew toward Satan.
Satan was tussling with Eoranth. After blocking the Annihilating Soul Beam, Satan zoomed up to where Eoranth was.
Eoranth was still protected by the Celestial Dragon Lifeforce. Using Celestial Shine didn't end the state, but he couldn't use the Celestial Shine anymore. That ultimate skill could be used only once every time he entered the state.
However, even with the buff from Celestial Dragon Lifeforce, it was evident Satan was still superior. Satan moved around Eoranth and punched him from multiple angles. Eoranth couldn't follow Satan's fast movements. He was reduced to a punching bag. To make matters worse, Satan wasn't using any skill. These were just his standard attacks. He wasn't even using his flaming weapon.
Satan continued throwing Eoranth flaming punches while giving him mocking laughs. "Harhar! I've played with you, stinky dragon, for quite a long time already. I think I've had enough. Just like I've had it enough with that old fool I killed just now. Or maybe I should say, you killed just now? Harhar!"
"Shut up!" Eoranth roared. He knew Honuren's death was not his fault. It was Satan's. Still, hearing Satan mocked him about it made him feel frustrated.
Eoranth used the Soul of Heaven and Earth. A huge rune diagram appeared under him. The whole space around him lit up then. No matter how fast Satan was, he didn't believe the devil could dodge getting hit by this skill for being too close to him.
While the energy from the Soul of Heaven and Earth was still raging, Satan suddenly came right to his face. Eoranth was taken by surprise because he failed to sense Satan's approach. Satan used mana concealment while his vision was blocked by his own raging energies.
Although Satan received damage, he didn't seem hindered by the raging energies. Before Eoranth could react, Satan revealed a gigantic flaming axe. This flaming axe was larger than his usual flaming weapon. It was also coated with silver and dark purple aura. Eoranth only managed to shift his position by a little when he saw the incoming axe. The axe failed to hit his body, but it hit his arm. He looked in disbelief as the flaming axe sliced his
arm clean off.
"GRAAWWLLLL...!!!"
A pained roar was let out from his mouth. His mind went blank for a second. He forced his consciousness to return. Even losing one second could be fatal when fighting an opponent as deadly as Satan. He looked around but couldn't find Satan. He also couldn't sense the devil.
He then felt a sudden impact on his back. Before he knew it, he was zooming at a high speed toward the ground.
Jeanny, who had almost arrived to help Eoranth, looked helplessly as the two titanic beings plummeted to the ground below. She couldn't catch up to their speed.
Satan slammed Eoranth into the ground by stepping his two feet on the dragon's back. His two hands were gripping Eoranth's wings. After they touched down, Satan made a violent pull using his hands while his feet kept Eoranth pinned to the ground.
Jeanny looked in horror as Eoranth's two wings were ripped apart from his back.
Eoranth lost a huge chunk of HP. His max HP also plummeted. He screamed and writhed on
the ground from the agony.
Satan didn't continue the punishment. He just stood there and watched in delight. His face seemed to be in ecstasy. His final form didn't only augment all his aspects, but it also drew out his wicked desires. He wanted to make his enemies suffer as much as possible.
"I am the undefeated of the Underworld! This is what you get if you cross me!" Satan
exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1965: Chapter 1965. A Bunch of Weaklings
chapters.content:
Chapter 1965:. A Bunch of Weaklings
Satan's brutality caused Jeanny to lose her nerve. She stopped in her tracks and didn't approach.
Satan continued to stand still as he watched Eoranth. Eoranth had stopped screaming. The pain was still unbearable, but he didn't want to give Satan the satisfaction of hearing his pained cry. He gritted his teeth while bearing the pain. A low growl resulted from his effort. Satan scoffed. "Trying to act brave, aren't you? Perhaps I should hurt you more."
He lifted his hand but stopped. He looked up. As he did, a change happened in the sky. It became stormy before a huge pillar of light shot down. Myriads of runic symbols adorned the surface of this pillar of light.
Satan felt a huge pressure following the descent of this light pillar. He grunted. In his final form, he had no problem overpowering this pressure. Yet, he didn't move. He conjured his Soul and Chaos Ring of Defense and placed it above him. The light pillar bathed him then.
The pillar of light was huge. Eoranth should be engulfed by the pillar as well since he was so close to Satan. Jeanny was the same since she was hovering above Satan but moved away when she saw the sky roiling. She was out of danger. She looked down because she was worried about Eoranth. She was surprised to find that Eoranth was also out of danger.
Eoranth was outside the area showered by the light pillar. A huge winged tiger carried him away. Jeanny knew this winged tiger well. The winged tiger was one of their guild guardians, Czar.
She saw the other guild guardians then. Penny, Gumeru, and Ladohn. They were all eternal grades. They were under the effect of the Oriental Guardian Beasts.
Jeanny heard John's voice from Gumeru's direction. "Jeanny, follow Penny! You support her!"
John and Paytowin were riding atop Gumeru's shell. Gumeru's shell possessed large dorsal ridges. These dorsal ridges provided John and Paytowin with covers. The two fired their ranged attacks from behind these covers.
It was John who called Tip to send the guild guardians over. Gumeru possessed a protective aura that covered the allies riding atop him, similar to the ability of the Caelum Whale. Even when the enemy used an AOE attack, the damage would be absorbed by the dragon turtle. The allies tagging Gumeru's shell suffered no damage. That's why John dared to join the fight.
Additionally, Gumeru was cruising the sky using his Dual-world Domain. With water around John, his stats were boosted due to his bloodline.
The guild guardians surrounded the light pillar from four different directions. Jeanny flew to where Penny was following John's instruction. Czar flew up to join his brethren after taking Eoranth a sufficient distance away. Eoranth was in no condition to continue the fight. Grace came to him and started healing him. She couldn't do anything about his missing arm and wings but could bring his HP back to a safe level.
The pillar of light finally dimmed. Satan was floating in his original spot. He didn't suffer any damage. He looked at the Soul and Chaos Ring of Defense in his hand. There was no new crack.
He looked up and laughed mockingly, "True Angel. You are weaker than my previous opponents. How dare you show yourself!"
Thanael floated down. After two months of constant training, he was level 96. The pillar of light just now was his spell, Purifying Heavenly Decree. Though this spell reduced a significant portion of Satan's HP in the past, it was because it dealt double damage to demons. The power of the spell itself was weaker than Eoranth's Annihilating Soul Beam. That's why the spell failed to cause any crack on Satan's ring of defense.
Satan also turned to the four guild guardians surrounding him. The four's levels had also increased. Penny was level 84, Gumeru was level 79, Czar was 85, and Ladohn was level 87.
Satan scoffed. "A bunch of weaklings," he ridiculed. The gentle flame of Flame Meditation ignited his already burning body. Recovery numbers came up rapidly above his head. Activating this skill showed he didn't put these new opponents in his eyes. He didn't believe they could make him move from this spot.
Thanael took the initiative to attack. He thrust the white lance in his right hand. A beam of light was generated by his thrust. At the same time, a large spear made of light was formed in his left hand. He threw this spear of light at Satan.
Satan showed no attempt to dodge the incoming attacks. Two fiery beams shot out from his eyes. One of the fiery beams hit the beam of light. The other crashed into the spear of light. Both light-element attacks were destroyed. The fiery beams went on. They were heading toward Thanael.
Thanael used Air Skate and moved away. The fiery beams made a sharp turn and chased after the angel. Thanael flapped his wings of light and flew at high speed. The fiery beams were hot on his tail.
When Thanael threw his spear of light, John gave the four guild guardians the signal to attack. Satan swung his hand after firing the fiery eye beams. A flaming whip materialized in his hand mid-swing. This flaming whip lashed in a circle. A flaming shockwave radiated from the whip. The four guild guardians just about to advance were shoved back.
Since they couldn't get close, they resorted to using ranged attacks. Penny fired her lava breath. Gumeru unleashed his steam breath. The water from his Dual-world domain was pulled by this steam breath. They formed a cyclone of water that rushed toward Satan. Czar released a violent gale of wind breath, and crackling lightning breath poured out of Ladohn. The four elemental breath attacks converged on Satan, who just stood there and received the attack. He laughed while taking the attacks head-on. A protective runic layer adorned his body. The damage he received didn't eclipse the healing from Flame Meditation.
"Damn it! We have to force him to move!" John exclaimed.
John sent a command to Tip to force the guild guardians to advance using the guild army command platform. He could feel the slight shivering from the dragon turtle. Satan's aura was too intimidating. The guild guardians might appear brave, but deep down, they were terrified of going up against the devil.
Under the forced command, Gumeru charged forward. His water rushed ahead of him. Satan simply looked at the incoming dragon turtle with a grin.
Before Gumeru came into melee range, Satan punched forward. A titanic flaming fist slammed into the turtle. The impact sent it flying back. The rolling caused John and Paytowin to get thrown off Gumeru's shell.
Jeanny, Ladohn, Czar, and Thanael came at Satan from behind when Gumeru was smacked away. Thanael finally managed to eliminate Satan's fiery eye beams after using multiple spells to exhaust the beams' energy. He was now charging at Satan with his lance filled with the energy of light. Czar turned into a hurricane and slashed Satan from all sides. Lightning blades assailed Satan as Ladohn's claws came at Satan's head. Jeanny used Heaven's spear while thrusting in between Ladohn's claws.
In response to these attacks, Satan's flaming weapon turned into a long stick. The flaming stick moved at incredible speed and struck the two guild guardians and guild hero. Jeanny managed to dodge thanks to her Dragon Lord Reflex. The flaming stick transformed into a hammer. With one circular swing, Satan smacked Czar, Ladohn, and Thanael. The attack missed Jeanny again, but the hammer produced a fiery wind following its swing. The wind slammed into Jeanny and sent her tumbling away while suffering damage.
Throughout the exchange, Satan was still at the same spot. His Flame Meditation never
stopped.
Jeanny left Penny because Penny had flown up into the sky. Not because she was fleeing. She was using her Diving Lava Beam. She was now diving at high speed toward Satan.
Satan looked up. His flaming weapon turned into a buckler. He didn't use the Soul and Chaos Ring of Defense. These opponents were not worthy enough.
Penny's Diving Lava Beam crashed into the flaming buckler. The pressure was strong but was nothing to Satan. He was about to utter a mocking laugh when he felt a stronger impact on his
buckler.
Penny didn't stop after unleashing her Diving Lava Beam. She continued diving and slammed her body into the flaming buckler. The impact caused the buckler to shift. From the opening, Penny fired her lava breath directly into Satan's face.
This took Satan aback. He involuntarily moved from his current spot and ended his Flame
Meditation.
Satan's face turned into a scowl. Ending the Flame Meditation wasn't a big deal. These opponents couldn't deal much damage to him anyway. What pissed him off was the fact that he ended the skill not on his term.
"You want to die? I will grant you your wish!" Satan roared.
A powerful blast erupted from him. This blast stunned Penny. Satan's buckler turned into a hammer again. It slammed into Penny and sent her flying straight down. Satan shot down
following her.
Czar and Ladohn used their extreme speed to come to Penny's rescue. However, Satan cast the Infernal Flame Wrath on his way down. Numerous huge fireballs flew at Czar and Ladohn,
obstructing them.
Penny fought the downward force. She managed to regain control as she was about to crash into the ground. She quickly flew away. Unfortunately, multiple fire rings abruptly appeared before her. She flew straight into these fire rings, which then tightened around the multiple parts of her body. She lost her flying ability and fell to the ground.
She tried to get up by walking. But before she could, a strong impact rammed into her rear. A sharp stinging pain followed afterward.
"No! Penny...!!" Jeanny called. She and Thanael were also rushing down, but they were not fast
enough.
Jeanny watched in horror as Satan severed Penny's two hindlegs using his axe. That axe was gleaming with soul and chaos energies. Satan was now lifting that axe high, ready to bring it down again. This time, his aim was on Penny's neck.

chapters.title: Chapter 1966: Chapter 1966. A Frustrating Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 1966:. A Frustrating Battle
When Honuren's lifeless body fell to the ground, Jack saw it from the corner of his eyes. He gritted his teeth. He wanted to do something but knew that he would just be throwing his life away if he engaged Satan in his current condition. The Devilize ability of his weapon had finished its cooldown. However, even using that skill would not give him the edge to go up against Satan in final form.
He needed something more powerful. Yet, what he was waiting for didn't come. Dajja had landed multiple eye skills on him. None of them was what he wished for.
Dajja started casting a spell. As he did, the air in front of him shimmered. He quickly dodged to the side as a black light appeared. Jack had used this ability a few times. Dajja learned that against this ability, using his eye to detect the changes in the air was more effective than sensing the disturbance of mana.
While dodging, Dajja found Jack appearing where he had dodged. Jack used Flame Strike and sent the eyeball demon crashing into the ground.
'I thought your objective was not defeating him?' Peniel asked through their mind.
Jack didn't answer. He knew he still needed Dajja. The strike just now was to vent his frustration.
Dajja quickly moved away before Jack could attack again. He was surprised by Jack's speed just now. But most of all, he was surprised Jack could conceal his mana. The mana concealment he experienced just now was probably more advanced than his Lord's.
Jack always attacked whenever Dajja was casting spells. Dajja chalked it up to him needing the casting time for spells, so Jack got the chance to attack. Dajja decided not to waste time casting spells until Jack was incapacitated. His eye glowed again as he executed another eye skill.
Jack sensed the attack. He did not attempt to dodge. When the skill hit, he felt like his head was slammed by a sledgehammer. Everything in his vision turned white.
"Peniel...," He called.
He heard no response from Peniel. He looked around. Everything remained white. He was no longer in supreme dragon form. Suddenly, dark spears appeared from all around and headed at him at high speed. Jack could move normally in this place. His mana sense also functioned normally. Utilizing his speed and mana sense, he dodged these spears.
"Shit... An eye skill that messes with the mind but didn't empty my thought," Jack cursed. This was not the skill he was expecting.
Another thing worried him. If he was busy dodging these spears in his mind, then what happened to his real body?
Using Hundred Synchronous Thoughts, he expanded his mana sense while dodging. This was his mind. His mana sense had no limit. With his mana sense affinity, he could detect what was happening outside. Thanks to his Time Sage class, he could also detect the discrepancy between the time here and outside.
The time that flowed inside here was many times faster than the outside. The time outside was as if at a standstill.
He heaved a sigh of relief. This meant his real body was not in danger. The dark spears assailing him, however, were a different matter. He was hit by one of these spears, and a damage number came up above him. His mana sense told him this damage was real.
He had tried using Flash Step to avoid the dark spear that hit him. It didn't work. Skills were not usable.
"What about weapons?" Jack asked. His sword and staff appeared in his hands.
"Great!" Jack stored his staff and split the Fallen Apostle's Longsword into two. He then performed Formless Flowing Sword Style.
Using the sword art, he could deflect all the incoming dark spears without receiving damage. It was around three hours later when he found himself back in his real body. As he did, the damage number equal to what he suffered from the dark spears came up above him.
'What a scary eye skill,' He thought.
In reality, it was less than a second since Dajja's eye skill, Mind Purgatory, hit him. But in his mind, three hours had passed. If he suffered enough damage during those three hours while he was trapped in his mind, he would die the instant he was out. All the damage he suffered inside was carried into the real world.
Even if the victim didn't die, any normal person would be disoriented to find himself back three hours before getting hit by the Mind Purgatory. Dajja was counting on this. He started casting a spell once he executed his eye skill.
Fortunately, Jack was not normal. He was already aware of the time difference due to his affinity for time. He moved the instant he was out. Sword of Light dashed out and struck Dajja in the eye. Normal skill would damage but wouldn't hurt Dajja's eye. Jack's skill was empowered by strong mana manipulation. Dajja felt stung in his eye. His spellcasting was canceled.
"F*ckk...!!" Dajja cursed. He was frustrated at not being given the chance to cast a spell.
Jack also wanted to curse. 'When are you going to use that eye skill, Goddamnit!' However, he didn't show it. If Dajja found out he intentionally allowed himself to get hit by eye skills, it would be a problem.
Failing to cast his spell, Dajja resorted to another eye skill.
All of a sudden, Jack saw Satan appearing right above him. Satan's fiery punch was coming down at him. This sudden attack scared the shit out of him. He stumbled backward and fell in the most un-hero-like manner, barely avoiding the fiery punch. The ground before him cracked from the punch. He felt the strong wind from the impact.
Something felt off, though. Although everything seemed real, he sensed no mana from the attack. Satan might have mana concealment, but not when he was attacking. Jack looked back and saw that Satan was still away. He was battling Everlasting Heavenly Legends' guild guardians who had just arrived.
"Damn it! It's an illusion," Jack cursed.
"Fools you, though," Peniel remarked.
The Satan above him sent another punch. This time, Jack ignored it. The fist went past him and crashed into the ground beneath him. He could feel the heat and wind from that punch, but no impact. He saw the ground below him collapsed, but his footing was stable. The illusion gave him a sense of vertigo. He admitted this illusion was as good as it could get. If not because of his mana sense, he would have believed all this.
Many seemingly powerful demons appeared and started attacking him. Jack knew they were all illusions as well. He noticed Dajja made another attempt at spellcasting.
"You stupid f*ck! Do you forget I have mana sense?!" Jack scolded and used Void Slash. He was pissed. Partly because Dajja still did not give him what he wanted, but mostly because the demon caused him to stumble disgracefully.
This time, Dajja almost completed his spell. Jack's Void Slash hit directly inside Dajja. The Void Slash was not only empowered by mana manipulation but was also altered with Form Manipulation into a spiraling vortex. It dealt continuous damage and was extremely disruptive. Dajja tried his best to maintain his concentration but failed at the last second.
"Raarrhhh...!!!" Dajja was also pissed. Why couldn't his eye skills distract this outworlder long enough for him to complete his spell? This was the first time he experienced a battle as
maddening as this.
"You push me to use this! Prepare to become an empty shell for eternity...!!!" Dajja exclaimed. His big eye shone ominously.
Again, Jack let the eye skill hit him even when he could have dodged it. His expression became
blank then.
"Oh...," Peniel uttered after seeing the effect.
Dajja didn't immediately cast a spell again. Instead, he moved a distance away. He stopped after quite a distance, but he still didn't cast a spell. He watched Jack again, making sure the outworlder had not moved. It seemed like this time, his eye skill worked.
He was tempted to leave the outworlder like that. Against weak-willed minds, they could be trapped in that condition for eternity. Not alive, but not dead either. It would be a fitting punishment to have caused him such a headache.
However, there was also a chance the target escaped the condition by himself. Dajja didn't want to take a chance. He started casting a spell. He wanted to eliminate this outworlder. He glanced at Satan while casting. It didn't look like Satan needed any help. It was not strange. Nothing below divine beings was Satan's equal when his lord was in Final Form. His spell formation was completed. The space around Jack cracked. It then crumbled. Everything within his spell's AOE turned into an empty void. This spell had an instant death effect. None absorbed by the void could survive.
"It's done!" Dajja exclaimed. He couldn't believe defeating a lone outworlder would be this
satisfying.
While he was celebrating, he sensed a disturbance from the void created by his spell. The space would return to normal with time, but it should still be a while before that. A small slit appeared in that void. Colorful light exuded from the slit.
While he was entranced by the weird phenomenon, the slit exploded. A silver beam coated with colorful light shot out. This beam slammed into him.
He tried moving away but couldn't. The beam was as if holding him. All the while, his HP dropped rapidly. He tried casting a spell but also couldn't. It was as if his mind was under attack. The silver beam widened. It was now so large it covered his entire body.
The beam was unending. He couldn't do anything to stop it.
"No... No!" He panicked. He tried sending a telepathic message to Satan but again, couldn't.
His every effort was blocked!
"NOOOO...!!!" His HP was finally depleted.
He became still as his body started to unravel. It broke apart bit by bit under the flood of the
silver beam until he was completely gone. The silver beam stopped then.
Dajja was as if never existed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1967: Chapter 1967. Mana Awakening Vs Final Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 1967:. Mana Awakening Vs Final Form
Satan was about to deliver a killing strike to slay Penny. His flaming axe, coated with soul and chaos energies, was on its way to Penny's neck. However, before the axe connected with its target, a beam shooting at a blinding speed struck the axe.
Satan failed to detect the beam not only because it was too fast, but also because he sensed no mana from that beam. However, the most surprising thing was the force from the beam caused him to take a step back. His attempt to slay the lava dragonet was foiled.
A shadow zoomed past Penny. The fire rings that bind her body burst apart. Penny was free. However, she couldn't move away because she had lost her hind legs. She was whimpering in pain on the ground. An invisible force lifted her body and sent her away.
"You...?!" Satan was surprised by the perpetrator who foiled his killing attempt.
That person was Jack, but Jack was unlike the outworlder he fought before. Jack was different. Jack was covered in a multicolor aura. He also couldn't sense Jack. While he knew Jack had mana concealment, it was slightly different this time. It was as if Jack's entire presence was concealed.
Yet, Jack was clearly in front of him.
"What happens to you?" Satan asked.
"I've been granted the power to defeat you," Jack replied.
"Heh, cute," Satan chuckled. He turned to where Dajja was. The last time he saw Dajja, the demon was fighting Jack.
Jack could guess what Satan was thinking. "No need to look. That eyeball demon is no more. I've slain him."
Satan frowned. Under normal circumstances, he would have laughed at such a statement. However, he had been sending telepathic messages to Dajja but failed to get a telepathic connection. Furthermore, there was something about Jack that made him feel wary.
"A*shole. Do you know how difficult it is to find a competent assistant?" Satan cursed.
"I do," Jack replied. He then disappeared.
He reappeared next to Satan's face and performed Flame Strike. The flame that burned following his swing was like a blazing inferno. It was incomparable to normal Flame Strike. When his flaming claw connected with Satan's face, the result was a fiery explosion the size of a city block.
The shockwave from the explosion threw Jeanny and the others away. Everyone was having trouble believing what Jack used just now was a basic skill.
Satan reeled from the strike. This was like the repeat of Jack's first strike when Jack proposed the duel. Same as then, he had been caught unaware by Jack's speed. His perception when he was in final form was superb. He could see Jack's movements. He was just unprepared for it.
He gritted his teeth. That first time, it was amusing to find an opponent who could give him such a surprise. This time, he no longer felt amused.
"Motherf*cking outworlder! Dieee...!!!" Raging flames burst from his body. His flaming fist shot at a blinding speed at Jack.
Jack didn't dodge the threatening-looking fist. He also punched. The two fists, one gigantic and the other one tiny, collided. Logic dictated that the tiny fist should be obliterated from the collision. Yet, the two fists seemed equal in strength. The shockwave from the impact caused the ground beneath them to crack and collapse.
A huge flaming hand appeared behind Jack. It attempted to grab Jack. But before it did, multiple black lights flashed out of thin air and sliced the flaming hand to pieces.
These black lights were Nine Yin Phantom Swords. Jack's current level of mana awakening allowed him to draw enough mana to form multiple phantom swords simultaneously. These black lights didn't stop after cutting the flaming hand. More flashed out and formed a net that trapped Satan. In addition, Jack's two claws moved at blinding speed, performing the final phase of Formless Flowing Sword Style. Black lights and sword lights swarmed Satan. This assault was impossible to dodge. Every square inch of Satan's body had either the black lights or the sword lights hitting it.
After getting into his final form, Satan's defense reached a new height. Even when an opponent successfully landed a strike, he didn't receive much damage. The current attack was different, though. The black lights had great piercing abilities. As for the sword lights, the combos multiplied the damage with time.
Before he suffered too much damage, Satan conjured the Soul and Chaos Rings of Defense on his two hands. These two rings spun and formed a sphere protecting his body, repelling the black lights and sword lights.
The soul and chaos sphere might have protected Satan from the assault, but that didn't mean he was safe. Jack used War God's Stride. He shifted past the protective sphere and came right before Satan. Before the devil could react, he used Devouring Cross. The attack damaged Satan and healed the HP he lost when fighting Dajja earlier.
Satan reeled back from the strike. A clear X-mark was seen on his chest where the Devouring Cross had landed.
"You, insufferable punk! I will end you!!" The flaming aureole behind Satan spun rapidly. It then discharged a massive flame pillar.
Jack used War God's Shield. His mana awakening let him repair the shield so he could use it earlier than he should. The golden shield was larger and thicker than normal. Its golden brilliance was so dense the shield was as if solid gold. The flame pillar was unable to burn through the shield.
The aureole behind Satan kept turning, but it wasn't for an offensive purpose. The aureole helped Satan manipulate another of his skills to shorten its cooldown. Before long, the flames on Satan's body changed color. Half was silver and the other half became dark purple. It was the Soul and Chaos Peak Flames. Together with his Final Form, just his aura alone could suffocate those in his vicinity. The air around him combusted, and the ground underneath him cracked even when he was not applying pressure.
Jack was unaffected, but he didn't underestimate his opponent. He activated Devilize.
After their transformations, the two vanished at almost the same time.
*BOOM!*BOOM!*BOOM!*
Multiple booming sounds were heard. Shockwaves of explosions occurred all around the place. These shockwaves reverberated far and wide. Their power was felt even from far away. The ground cracked and shattered from the force. As for those nearby who watched, they had to move away again and again every time the shockwaves hit them.
They couldn't see the battle. Both Jack and Satan were moving at a speed that was impossible to perceive. Even Grace, with her incredible eyesight, couldn't see the two.
John told Tip to pull back Gumeru, Czar, and Lodahn. The current battle was not one these guild guardians could help with. As for Penny, Grace came over and used her healing spells to bring Penny's HP up. But like Eoranth, Penny couldn't fight anymore. They had to wait until Tip unsummoned the guild army before she could be treated in the guild headquarters. John, Jeanny, Grace, and Paytowin continued watching from a distance. They remained on standby even when they couldn't lend a hand. But rather than watching, it was more correct to say they were listening to the battle. The only indication that a battle was taking place was the booming sounds that kept on echoing. It was also from these sounds that they knew the battle was picking up in altitude. Jack and Satan were getting higher into the sky as their battle
proceeded.
Another huge shockwave happened high in the sky. This shockwave blew away all the clouds, clearing up the sky. This last shockwave was followed by silence afterward. Jack and Satan were still as they watched one another.
"Im... Impossible... How can an outworlder like you be this strong?" Satan asked. "Not to mention, you are not this strong earlier. Where did you get this kind of power?"
Jack grinned. "Don't you want to know?"
Satan's face turned into an ugly scowl. "Don't think you have a chance, Storm Wind! No matter how hard you try, a single outworlder will never defeat a devil! Much less a devil like
me!!"
Satan might be saying that, but he knew the most after the exchange just now. Jack had the advantage. Despite their lightning-speed bouts, Jack's actions remained precise. This was thanks to the peak state of his Sword's Heart. Satan was the one who kept losing HP, while Jack didn't receive any damage. His HP, which had healed to almost fifty percent before he and Jack went back to dueling, had now fallen back to thirty percent again. This was even after he activated the Soul and Chaos Peak Flames.
The flaming aureole behind Satan continued to spin. It was stretching the duration of the Soul and Chaos Peak Flames, making it last longer than its natural duration. Though Jack had the advantage, he wasn't without worry. He knew his mana awakening wasn't indefinite. If he maintained it more than his body could handle, he would go into a blackout. If that happened, he would be finished. He had to defeat Satan before that!

chapters.title: Chapter 1968: Chapter 1968. Defying All Sense
chapters.content:
Chapter 1968:. Defying All Sense
Despite the urgency, Jack feigned calmness. He grinned mockingly and said to Satan, "I have no chance? Why is your tone doesn't sound as confident as your words?"
"F*ck youuu...!!!" Satan cursed. His two hands aimed forward. Multiple soul and chaos bombs were fired from those hands.
Jack cast Magic Bombs. The ten energy balls conjured by the spell were ten times the size of normal magic bombs. These bombs exploded mid-flight. The AOE energies produced by the explosions covered a large portion of the sky. These AOE energies became a wall that blocked Satan's Soul and Chaos Bombs. The Soul and Chaos Bombs exploded upon touching this energy wall.
Satan didn't let up. The Soul and Chaos Bombs continued to shoot out from his hands unendingly.
While that happened, Jack sent a message to John and the others. "Get ready!"
"Does your Strength of Hope finish its cooldown?" John asked.
"It has already finished its cooldown some time ago," Jack answered. "I'm waiting for one spell to complete its cooldown. It shouldn't be long now."
The Soul and Chaos Bombs scraped the energy wall formed by Jack's Magic Bombs. Suddenly, thirty thick beams pierced out of the wall. These beams traveled in zig-zag patterns, targeting the Soul and Chaos Bombs. Each bomb they pierced through exploded. Yet, the beams themselves didn't diminish. They continued to destroy the Soul and Chaos Bombs while closing in on Satan.
These beams were Jack's Tracing Light Beams. But if someone witnessed the spell at this moment, they wouldn't believe the beams were from that spell.
When the beams got dangerously close, Satan brought out his Soul and Chaos Ring of Defense. The defensive ring blocked the first wave of beams that arrived. The following beams spread and came at Satan from all other directions that were not covered by the defensive ring.
Satan split the ring into two again and spun them, forming a protective sphere. The beams crashed into this sphere. None of the beams could penetrate the defense. The defensive rings were augmented by Satan's Final Form and the Soul and Chaos Peak Flames. It was sturdy enough to endure the ridiculously empowered Tracing Light Beams.
When Satan thought himself safe inside his defensive sphere, he felt a distortion of space. He didn't have the time to react. A sharp spatial energy pierced out of his chest. This was Jack's Void Slash. It bypassed the defensive sphere and directly hit Satan.
"Graahhh...!"
The stinging pain was unbearable. Black blood spurted from the wound. This caused his control to waver. The defensive sphere protecting him returned to being two defensive rings. Fortunately, Jack's Tracing Light Beams had been exhausted. However, a surprising sight greeted him.
Jack was all around him. Thousands of him, at least. Jack had cast Hundred Mirages. Under the boost of Mana Manipulation, the illusions he produced were way more than the spell's original effect.
Satan was baffled by the scene. Each of these illusions had Jack's mana signature. While he was unsure about what to do, he received a hit on his back. He turned but saw no one there. None of Jack's illusions were near him.
He then felt another impact on his side. He still couldn't see his attacker or sense any presence.
He started swinging his arms blindly. Soul and Chaos Bombs were thrown in random directions. Yet, the invisible assailant continued to strike him again and again. To make matters worse, the illusions around him started to move randomly. Some came to attack him, which made it even more difficult for him to detect the real aggressor.
The real aggressor was, of course, Jack. He was invisible because he had cast Invisibility. Under mana awakening, he could alter the spell to an extent where he didn't lose invisibility even after making physical contact with the enemy. Combined with his mana concealment, he had become truly undetectable.
Satan continued to lose HP under Jack's invisible onslaught. Jack even combined his assault with the Nine Yin Phantom Swords. Black lights sliced Satan's body while invisible strikes continued to land.
"Raaggh..!! Damn you! I'm going to crush you...!!!"
Satan kept flailing his arms around. Searing flames followed his swings. They blasted the space around him. The Soul and Chaos Rings of Defense were on those arms. The rings were also potent weapons. He hoped the rings could cut his invisible opponent with a lucky hit.
All the while, the aureole behind him spun rapidly. He was shortening the cooldown of another spell. This act was not without cost, though. His MP dropped rapidly following the aureole's spin.
Despite his efforts, Jack continued to land hits on him. Running out of ideas, he again spun the Soul and Chaos Rings of Defense and formed a defensive sphere.
He felt several impacts on his defensive sphere. Those attacks failed to penetrate his sphere. He felt safe again, but that also changed soon.
He again sensed the distortion in space. Unlike before, it was not from within his defensive sphere but outside.
Outside, a thin black line sliced through Satan's defensive sphere. Upon closer inspection, this thin black line was a tear in space. It was Jack's Void-tearing Slash. A skill that caused a huge tear in space was now compressed to a tiny line. This amplified the sharpness of the slash by many folds.
Satan's Soul and Chaos Rings of Defense stopped spinning. As they did, the rings split into
two.
"Im-Impossible...!" Satan had a hard time believing what had happened. These rings were his strongest defense.
The aureole behind him stopped spinning. He had finished refreshing his skill.
"I'm going to kill yoouuuu...!!!"
Following his roar, soul and chaos orbs appeared in his hands. He slammed these two orbs together. The skill he refreshed was the Soul and Chaos Chain Reaction.
An energy sphere, half silver, half dark purple, grew with Satan in its center. The sphere covered a tremendous area. All of Jack's illusions were devoured by this sphere. Because of the boost from the Final Form and the Soul and Chaos Peak Flames, the power and AOE of this skill were augmented. It covered almost three times the skill's normal coverage.
John, who had taken care to consider the chance of Satan using Soul and Chaos Chain Reaction, didn't expect this. He led everyone to stay outside the reach of the skill's normal range. When the menacing sphere came at them at breakneck speed, he was at a loss about what to do.
However, when the silver and dark purple sphere washed over them, they were surprised to find themselves without harm. The Soul and Chaos energies were all around them, ravaging everything. Yet, these energies didn't touch them. They were as if in a bubble where the destructive energies couldn't enter. They didn't even sense the energy raging outside the
bubble.
When they were still bewildered about what was happening, Jack appeared next to them. His sudden appearance made them all jump in surprise.
"Whoa! How the hell did you appear here?" Paytowin exclaimed.
"I've been here since before this Soul and Chaos Chain Reaction arrived," Jack answered. "I'm
simply invisible."
"... This is your doing?" John asked. He was referring to the bubble that protected them.
Jack nodded. "It's my Void Defense. Normally, the skill only protects me. My mana awakening let me alter the skill so it covers an area."
"Damn! That mana awakening truly throws all the rules into the bin," Paytowin remarked.
"It certainly defies all sense," John agreed.
"Can you defeat Satan?" Jeanny asked.
"... I can, but not fast enough," Jack answered. "I can feel it. I'm approaching my limit. If I don't end this mana awakening soon, I will go into a blackout. I can't defeat Satan with the
little time I have."
"So... should we retreat?" Paytowin asked.
"I cannot defeat Satan alone. But together, we can," Jack uttered.
"How can we help?" Grace asked.
"By using Hope's Light. Place your hands on my back!" Jack told them.
"Wait! If you are using Hope's Light, shouldn't I be at the center?" John asked.
"My mana awakening grants me better aim. Don't worry. As long as you people don't fight it,
I can draw Hope's Sanctification from your bodies."
The four complied and placed their hands on Jack's back. Aside from John, everyone activated their Hope's Sanctification. Their chests started to glow. The four behind Jack felt an invisible force enter them. They didn't fight it. A thread of light came out of the glow in their chests. It wormed its way through their arms and into Jack.
The light on Jack's chest intensified.
"Hey, I thought you said you are waiting for one spell to finish its cooldown?" John asked.
"Yes," Jack answered. "That spell is needed to ensure Satan cannot escape Hope's Light. It has come off cooldown. That's why I am here."
The Soul and Chaos Chain Reaction finally ended. Satan looked around the place. He was wary.
He couldn't sense Jack. He didn't know if Jack was still invisible. After searching around, he finally saw Jack with the other outworlders a great distance away. Those five outworlders were
covered in worrisome light.
"Then, what are you waiting for? Hurry up and..."
John's words stopped because, at that moment, Jack used Time Stop.

chapters.title: Chapter 1969: Chapter 1969. The Battle is Over
chapters.content:
Chapter 1969:. The Battle is Over
Jack saw Satan notice them. The devil was about to do something but stopped in his tracks once Jack activated Time Stop.
"John and the others are also not moving," Peniel told Jack.
"Not everything is possible with mana awakening," Jack said. "The spell still only lets our time flow while everything else stops. I can't alter that, but I can extend its duration."
"What about Hope's Light?" Peniel asked.
"Don't worry. The energies of their Hope's Sanctification had already passed onto me," Jack answered. He was pointing his finger in Satan's direction, which was a speck in the distance. Under normal conditions, Hope's Light couldn't reach a target from such a great distance. Thankfully, Jack, who had control of the trigger, was not under a normal condition. The multicolor aura from mana awakening blanketed the bright light in his chest. This multicolor aura slowly seeped into the light. The white light of Hope's sanctification mixed with this colorful aura.
Jack guided the two energies so they didn't oppose one another. Once he sensed the two merged, he released the trigger. The light on his chest abruptly vanished.
Far away, at the spot where Satan was. A ball of light appeared. This ball of light grew rapidly to a size that looked massive, even from where Jack was. Inside this huge ball of white were swirling multicolor waves. At the center of it all was Satan.
Satan was not visible from outside the ball of light, but Jack's dragon eye, augmented by mana awakening, could pierce through the light and see Satan. The devil remained still. The power of Hope's Light and the swirling multicolor waves slowly scraped Satan. The devil was erased one layer at a time. At first, the thin fiery layer enveloping him was doused. Then, his crimson scales turned to dust. His massive horns dissolved, starting from their tips. Satan was slowly getting erased, similar to what happened to the Eldritch Beholder when Broidrireg cast Permanent Delete.
Satan's time was stopped. He wasn't aware of what was happening. From his point of view, he was about to use a skill that could cover a great distance and disrupt the outworlders. The next second, he ceased to exist. If he retained his consciousness in the afterlife, he wouldn't be able to explain how he died.
Satan's body was scraped until it was only its heart left. Then, this heart also turned to dust. He was completely gone, as if he never existed. Jack summoned his Runestone of Luck when that happened.
The ball of light slowly faded before disappearing altogether, leaving only a clear sky. The time stop also ended.
"... use it!"
John resumed his words, but he then noticed he could no longer see the speck in the distance, which was Satan.
"Huh? Where is Satan? Did he use a movement skill?" Paytowin asked. His vision while wearing the Alpha Techno Suit was enhanced. He could see long-distance targets. His visor could also scan his field of view to detect hostiles. He looked around, but his visor didn't pick up Satan's presence.
"You are no longer under mana awakening," Jeanny said when he noticed Jack was no longer covered in the multicolor aura.
"Has Satan been defeated?" Grace asked. Jack didn't lose consciousness after losing mana awakening. This meant he ended it deliberately.
Jack turned to them with a smile. "Yes. The devil has been defeated. The battle is over."
John and the others looked at each other. They were having difficulty accepting that. One second, the devil was there. The next, he was no more. Those here knew Jack had Time Stop, but it was still difficult to wrap their heads around it.
Jack noticed the battling armies in the opposite distance. "Sadly, the war is not yet over. Let's go help them."
"Leave them to us. You must be exhausted," Jeanny said.
When the four were about to leave, Jack said, "Satan should have dropped loots. Let's go and pick them up first."
"They are yours," Jeanny stated.
"I couldn't have defeated Satan on my own," Jack said. "It was Hope's Light that defeated him, so we defeated them together. The loot should be shared."
"You fought Satan alone the majority of the time. We only assisted a little. The loots are yours," Jeanny returned.
When John was about to say something, Jeanny shut him up with a hard stare.
"Well, if you all insist. All right," Jack said.
Jeanny and the others turned and headed toward the battling armies. As they did, they crossed paths with a native healer. This native healer flew to where Honuren was and started casting a spell.
When Honuren fell, John sent a message to Tip and Linda, asking if they still had a spare resurrection potion. Unfortunately, they ran out of resurrection potions. Tip and Linda put on a broadcast to the armies. Most healers with the resurrection spell, which were not many, still had those spells on cooldown. Many fell during the war, so the spell was always cast whenever it was off cooldown. Fortunately, one healer with the resurrection spell from the Council of Elpo had the spell available.
After receiving the news, this healer hurriedly flew to Honuren. Honuren was their faction leader, after all.
It was not yet one hour. Jack was glad that Honuren could be saved. The old man was the third native Jack met since the world turned. The first two were Goddess Serenity and Peniel. But to most outworlders, Honuren was the first native.
Jack first went to the spot where he slew Dajja. It was closer. He rushed to battle Satan after killing the eyeball demon. Penny was in danger of getting killed, so he didn't waste time picking up the loot. When he arrived, the loots were still there.
Dajja dropped a considerable number of coins and mana cores. Many equipment, materials, and ingredients littered the ground. As a top demon, he dropped many loots even without Jack using the Runestone of Luck. Most of those drops were super rare, unique, and a few legendary. Jack did not need them. His equipment was all legendary grades except for one ring. There was no legendary ring among the pile, sadly.
However, one loot drew his attention, a technique book. He picked up the book and learned that it contained an eye skill called Mind- annihilating Gaze.
"Is this...?"
"Yes, that is the eye skill that hit you earlier," Peniel said. "It is the stronger version of Azzralith's Mind-dooming Gaze where it has no level restriction."
"Yeesss...!!" Jack jumped in celebration. Now, he no longer needed to rely on others to trigger Mana Awakening.
He didn't waste any time. He immediately learned the skill on the spot. The skill didn't have levels. At zero star, it had a cooldown of twelve hours. Peniel informed Jack that at ten stars, the cooldown was halved to six hours.
Jack stored the other loots before moving away. He looked over and saw Honuren had been resurrected. Honuren understood Satan was no more after looking around. He nodded to Jack, who nodded back. He then flew with the healer back to the battlefield.
Before Jack went to where Satan's loots dropped, he first went to Eoranth. The dragon was still lying weakly on the ground. Like other natives, Eoranth had to either go to the Church of Creation or drink a Reconstruct Potion to regrow his limbs.
"How are you doing?" Jack asked.
The dragon was not in immediate danger. Grace had healed Eoranth to almost half his HP. His HP continued to recover slowly. His max HP, however, was reduced to 70%. He needed to
regrow his limbs and wings before his HP bar returned to 100%.
"I'm still alive. That's something, I guess," Eoranth answered.
Eoranth was eyeing Jack with mixed feelings. He agreed to be Themisphere's country guardian to honor Broidrireg's dying wish. He had no interest in the role otherwise. He never understood why Broidrireg accepted the role previously. He was even more at a loss about why the elder dragon showed such respect toward Jack.
After he lost the ability to fight, he never stopped witnessing the battle between Satan and the others. Like Satan, he couldn't comprehend how Jack gained such power. He also didn't understand how Satan perished. The devil was there, then he was not. Yet, Eoranth did not
doubt it was Jack's doing.
"Good job," Eoranth told Jack.
"I wouldn't have pulled it if you didn't hold Satan at bay," Jack said. "Stay put and rest. You have done enough. Once the war is over, I will have my guild member give you a Reconstruct Potion. We gained a recipe for that legendary-grade potion recently. It requires many high- grade ingredients, but my guild has them. Once we finish brewing it, you will get one."
"... Thanks," Eoranth said.
"Don't mention it," Jack replied. He took out his King Badge and said, "I will send you back to
Thereath, where it is safe."
"Send me later," Eoranth uttered. "Here is safe. I want to see the aftermath of the war."
"All right," Jack respected Eoranth's wish. He left the dragon and went to the place where
Satan fell.

chapters.title: Chapter 1970: Chapter 1970. Organizing Skills and Levels
chapters.content:
Chapter 1970:. Organizing Skills and Levels
The loots Satan dropped were even more than Dajja. The grades were also higher on average. This was not strange, considering Jack used the Runestone of Luck when Satan died.
He stored all the gold coins, mana cores, equipment, materials, and ingredients. Most of those he would donate to the guild. He kept one equipment because it was the only legendary gear he was missing, a ring.
*
Ring of Devil Incarnate (Legendary accessory).
All stats +30
All elemental resistance +70
10% chance to deal double damage. Cooldown after triggering double damage: 1 minute
Skills and spells have a 25% chance to ignore barriers. Cooldown after triggering ignore barriers: 5 minutes
Devil Blood (active ability): All attributes +200%. Defense +100%. Resistance +50. Increase damage based on HP loss (up to a maximum of 100%). When HP falls to 60% and 30% for the first time, deal 1000% chaos damage to the nearest hostile. Duration: 30 minutes. Cooldown: 6 hours
*
He replaced his Ring of Heroism with this legendary ring. Now, all his equipment was legendary grades.
Aside from the ring, four other items caught his interest. The first was a unique-grade technique book. It contained the skill, Devil Eye Flare. It was another eye skill but an offensive one. Peniel explained this skill was what Satan used when he shot fire beams from the eyes.
Jack learned the skill without delay.
*
Devil Eye Flare (Active skill)
Shoot two beams from the eyes. Each beam deals 1000% fire damage and can chase targets separately.
50% chance to inflict Burn and Rage.
Cooldown: 30 minutes
*
The next loot was also a technique book, but its grade was legendary. The skill contained inside was called the Runic Ring of Defense.
"Not the Soul and Chaos Ring of Defense?" Jack uttered with a disappointed tone.
"The Soul and Chaos Ring of Defense is a skill unique to Satan. No one else can learn it," Peniel explained. "This is the next best thing."
Jack also didn't waste time learning this skill.
*
Runic Ring of Defense (Special skill).
Create a ring that blocks damage. The ring's defense is affected by overall stats.
Cooldown if the ring is destroyed: 3 hours
*
"Another skill with stingy info," Jack remarked.
"If you need to know, that ring is more durable than the War God's Shield," Peniel informed. "If the ring is not broken, any attack blocked by the ring will not harm you. So, it is not just damage reduction."
"Cool," Jack uttered.
Since this Runic Ring of Defense had no duration, Jack tested it. A ring made of light appeared on his hand. Its size was as large as his body. The ring had runic symbols adorning its edge. Jack cast an Ice Bullet and used mana manipulation to control it to fly back toward himself. He placed the ring before him. Although it was shaped like a ring, which was hollow at the center, the ice bullet was destroyed when it crashed into this seemingly hollow center.
"Hm...," He thought about using a stronger skill to test the ring's durability but decided not to waste time doing that. He could join the ongoing war and test the ring in real combat.
The ring disappeared from his hand.
Both the skills he just learned were independent elite skills. They were not bound to a class. Any elite class could learn them. Like his other independent skills, these two skills didn't have a level. Their improvements were the star upgrades.
The third loot that got his attention was a legendary-grade Evolve Seed. Its name was Demonic Seed. Peniel explained this seed was best used on an offensive skill. The next best thing to use this seed on was a buff skill.
Jack decided to use the seed on his supposedly most powerful offensive skill, which he just gained. After defeating Satan and Dajja, he leveled up again. All three of his classes level up one time. His Beast Monarch was originally locked out from receiving exp points, but both Void Sword Saint and Time Sage had increased to the highest level of 99. There were still exp points left, so they went to the Beast Monarch, which was now level 95.
Like others with the pinnacle classes, he received a skill when he reached this highest level. The new skill of Void Sword Saint was an offensive skill.
*
Void Living Sword, level 1/20. (Active skill, range, requires sword).
Create a sentient sword made of void. The sword dealt 300% chaos damage with each slash.
All attacks received by the sword are absorbed by the void and can be redirected.
The sword possesses a gravitational field that affects its vicinity, slowing all hostiles within
its range.
Each hit has a 1% chance of causing instant death.
Has a very high chance of wounding a hit target.
Duration: 1 minute.
Stamina: 500
Cooldown: 2 hours
*
Jack decided to use the Demonic Seed on this skill. After absorbing the seed, the Void Living Sword changed its name to Void Demon Sword.
*
Void Demon Sword, level 1/20. (Active skill, range, requires sword).
Create a sentient sword made of void. The sword dealt 500% chaos damage with each slash.
All attacks received by the sword are absorbed by the void and altered into demonic spirit swords that strike distant enemies.
The sword possesses a demonic field that slows all enemies within its vicinity and deals 50%
magical damage each second.
Each hit has a 1% chance of causing instant death.
Has a very high chance of wounding a hit target.
Duration: 1 minute.
Stamina: 500
Cooldown: 2 hours
*
Jack was very eager to test this skill. He looked over to the warring armies.
"Later," he said to himself.
He took out his Container of Souls. Inside the container was an incredible number of souls. They came from the demons defeated by him and the armies several days earlier, but the biggest portion came from Satan and Dajja. As the number one devil and the number one demon, the souls generated by the two's death were incomparable to any foes he had
vanquished before.
Inside his Container of Souls were 15,600,000 souls.
He had 6 free skill points from Void Sword Saint. Adding 1,300,000 souls, he leveled up the
Void Demon Sword to its maximum level. Every level increased the chaos damage by 25%, the magical damage by 2.5%, and the duration by 6 seconds. At max level, Void Demon Sword dealt 1000% chaos damage with each slash. All enemies within its vicinity received 100% magical damage each second. The skill's duration was now 3 minutes.
Jack further upgraded the skill by spending 3,000,000 souls to give it ten stars. Each star of Void Demon Sword made its gravitational power stronger and increased the instant death chance by 0.4%. At ten stars, the instant death chance was 5%.
Jack again had to stymie his desire to try out the skill. He turned his attention to his other class. The Time Sage's ultimate spell was Time Reverse.
*
Time Reverse, level 1/20 (Active spell)
Turn back time by 20 seconds.
Cooldown: 2 hours
Mana: 600
*
It was a simple description, but its singular effect didn't need much explanation. Among the pinnacle classes, Time Sage was the only one devoid of offensive spells. Even so, Jack didn't think Time Sage was inferior to the other pinnacle classes. If anything, this class had the best support. By controlling time, one could control the flow of combat.
Jack wasted no time maximizing the spell. He spent Time Sage's 6 free skill points and 4,300,000 souls to upgrade the spell to level 20 and ten stars. Each level increased its duration by 2 seconds. Each star reduced its cooldown by 6 minutes. At level 20 and ten stars, Time Reverse could reverse time by one minute. Its cooldown was reduced to only one hour.
He still had 7,000,000 souls. He used it to upgrade the other new skills he had just learned. He spent 6,000,000 souls to fully upgrade the Devil Eye Stare and the Runic Ring of Defense. Each star of Devil Eye Stare increased the fire damage by 50% and decreased its cooldown by 2 minutes. At ten stars, each beam dealt 1500% fire damage. Its cooldown was only ten minutes. The durability of the Runic Ring of Defense increased with each star. Its cooldown was also
reduced by 12 minutes per star. At ten stars, Jack only needed to wait one hour if the ring was destroyed.
He then used 900,000 souls for Dragon Eye. Its seven stars were upgraded to ten stars. The active effect of the skill now lasted thirty seconds.
The remaining 100,000 souls he used in conjunction with Beast Monarch's 3 free skill points to level up Demonize Pet to level 11. The skill now lasted 45 minutes.
Jack also gained 15 free attribute points from his level-ups. He spent them on his Endurance
stat.
Now that he had gained all the available skills from his classes, he figured it was time to use
the level-down pills. He had stocked up a number of these pills during his past visits to the
underworld.
He didn't use the pills on the Void Sword Saint and Time Sage. If he did, he would lose the
ability to use the Void Demon Sword and Time Reverse. Both skills would still be on his skill
page but would be unusable. Hence, he only used them on Beast Monarch, which only granted free skills up to level 90.
He used five level-down pills and brought Beast Monarch back to level 90. He would need
fewer exp points to level up at that level. This way, he could continue increasing his stats without losing any skills.
Done organizing his skills and levels, he turned to the last loot dropped by Satan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1971: Chapter 1971. Using the Newly Gained Skills
chapters.content:
Chapter 1971:. Using the Newly Gained Skills
The last loot was a legendary-grade runestone. Its name was Runestone of the Devil King. "It is another of those rare battle runestones," Peniel informed. "Like your Runestone of Spellcasting and Haon's Runestone of Combat, it can help you during combat."
"It will give me buff?" Jack asked.
"It's... a bit complicated," Peniel replied. "If you can master it, you will be stronger with that runestone active. That said, I imagine it will be rather difficult for you to master this runestone."
"Huh, why?" Jack asked.
"Give it a try, and you will understand," Peniel answered.
Jack rolled his eyes at his fairy companion. She still had her penchant for withholding information.
Jack thought about trying to fuse with the runestone like Peniel suggested, but he decided to do it later. Fusing with a runestone required time. Since Peniel said fusing with this runestone would be difficult, it should take an even longer time. The war was still ongoing. It would be a waste to throw away all those potential exp points.
"Considering this runestone is already a legendary grade, I no longer need gemstones to upgrade it," Jack said.
"Yes. That runestone is already perfect in its basic form," Peniel confirmed.
Jack nodded. He stored the runestone before shooting into the sky. He flew at high speed toward the battlefield.
He watched the scene as he approached. The defenders could already fight the underworld force on even grounds when Jack joined the battle. With Satan's demise, the battle tipped further in the defenders' favor. It was only a matter of time until the demons were vanquished.
Jack preferred it to be sooner. They needed to march into Liguritudum as quickly as possible. He looked around for a place with more enemies. After locating the spot, he dashed over.
"Time to test your power!" Jack exclaimed. He used the Void Demon Sword.
When the sword appeared, he was taken aback. The reason was the sword's size. He thought it would be a normal-sized sword, or at most, the size of a greatsword. However, the sword that appeared was freaking huge. It was the size of a small ship. It was probably a hundred meters in length.
The sword was composed of voids. When one looked at its surface, one could almost gleam a different world behind that void. The gigantic sword rushed forward when Jack was still processing its appearance.
With its gigantic mass, it swept through many demons at once. With one sweep, many were killed. Some were because their HP was already low. Another portion was because they received the instant-death effect. The remaining were due to suffering fatal wounds, like having their heads decapitated. Half of those who survived suffered wounds that weakened their fighting abilities and reduced their max HP.
The Void Demon Sword was not slow. It was also sentient. It detected nearby enemies and zoomed over, cutting many demons as it slashed past. The demons tried to move away when they saw this giant flying sword come over, but the slow ones found their bodies becoming heavy when the sword approached. They also received small damage every second. They were helpless as the void sword sliced into them.
Some tried using attacks to break the sword. However, all their attacks were as if sinking into a bottomless abyss. No apparent damage was visible on the sword. To make matters worse, several small swords started flying out from inside the void of the giant sword. These small swords spread out and struck the demons not in the giant sword's trajectory.
The demons had no means to destroy the Void Demon Sword. Defensive skills or spells still worked in reducing the damage they received. But since the Void Demon Sword had an instant-death effect and had a high chance of wounding, those defensive abilities were largely ineffective. The best move to deal with this void sword was not getting hit, but the demonic field it exuded rendered even that difficult.
In a short time, the demons' formation at the place where Jack was was a total mess. Jack hadn't even done anything else after conjuring the Void Demon Sword. The demons were too busy dealing with the void sword to do anything to Jack, who just floated above them.
One unfortunate thing was that this void sword dealt friendly fire. If allies were in the sword's path, they suffered damage too. The sword was sentient and tried to avoid allies. But with its bulky build, collateral damage was bound to happen sooner or later.
Jack had chosen an area where more enemies were grouped. But with how chaotic the battlefield was, some allies were there as well.
At one unfortunate instant, an ally was cut by the void sword together with the demons. The worst thing happened. The wounding effect triggered. That ally's body was cut in two, and he died instantly.
"Oh, shit!" Jack exclaimed. Even though it was unintentional, he still felt a grave guilt seeing the scene.
The killed ally was a strong combatant, a level 85 mythical grade from the Council of Elpo. Losing such a combatant was a great loss.
"Your new spell!" Peniel reminded Jack. She sensed the guilty feeling within Jack's heart.
"Right!" Jack remembered. He hurriedly cast Time Reverse.
The Time Reverse turned back time by one minute. The spell was a nine-rune spell, but the runes composing the spell formation were not too intricate. This let Jack cast the spell
quickly.
After casting the spell, time started to flow backward. He saw himself and everything around him move back in time as if watching a rewinding video. It was the same sensation as the time when he was doing the trial for the Time Sage.
As he saw everything moving back in time, his mana manipulation informed him that he could exert control over the process and stop it if he wanted. This meant he didn't need to go all the way back to one minute before he cast the spell.
He tested doing that and stopped the process. Unfortunately, he learned that even if he stopped the process midway, the cooldown was still a full hour. He stopped the time reverse just a few seconds before the unfortunate ally was killed by his void sword. He used Wind Dash and zoomed toward the ally.
The ally was startled when Jack suddenly appeared before him. Jack grabbed him and used the second dash to pull him away. The ally was dazed by Jack's interference, but he soon noticed the void sword charging past where he used to be. He had been so absorbed in the battle that he failed to sense the incoming sword. He understood then why Jack pulled him away. "Tha... Thank you...," he stammered.
Jack gave him a friendly tap. "Leave this place to me. You go help the others," Jack told him. The ally didn't disagree. He went away.
Jack returned his attention to the void sword still causing havoc among the demons. His Time Reverse had a one-hour cooldown. If the same incident happened again before the cooldown ended, he wouldn't be able to undo it.
"Hm... Let's see if I can control it," Jack uttered.
He used mana manipulation to strengthen the connection between him and the void sword. Once the link became clear, he knew he could influence the sword. He controlled it to go after the higher-grade and higher-level demons. He also empowered it, making it deal more damage and move faster. His current level of mana manipulation was advanced enough for him to do this, even when this was his first time using the skill.
Under his control, Jack made the void sword perform sword arts. He couldn't perform Formless Flowing Sword Style. That art needed at least two swords, but he could perform One-word Slash and One-word Thrust.
When he performed those sword arts, a void line was created following the slash or thrust. This void line lingered for several seconds. Demons who touched this void line received damage. Additionally, using the sword arts seemed to increase its instant-death and wounding effects. The rate at which the demons died increased.
Although the Void Demon Sword lasted only three minutes, it left a long trail of dead demons
after it ended.
"Hehe. That was one deadly skill," Jack remarked.
"You must thank the demonic seed. The original Void Living Sword isn't that big and fast,"
Peniel informed.
The surviving demons turned to Jack. If it was before, they would have looked at Jack in fury accompanied by the desire to tear Jack apart, but they were under the debuffing effects after losing Satan. What their eyes expressed was fear and anxiety. They couldn't bring themselves to retaliate. They just stood there with dreadful stares, until one of the stronger demons
uttered a rallying cry.
"What are you all doing? We are the mighty force of the underworld. Attacckkk...!!!"
Not all the demons acted, but enough did. They sent ranged attacks before they charged forward. Jack didn't worry. He looked at the incoming attacks with a smile. The Runic Ring of Defense appeared before him. He used mana manipulation to empower the ring. The ring spun and flared brightly due to the injection of mana.
All the incoming attacks were blocked by the ring. Jack received no damage. There was also no visible crack on it. The ring was more durable than he expected.
Jack used another new skill, Devil Eye Flare. Two fiery beams shot out from his eyes. The two beams sneaked through the horde of incoming demons and struck the demon who had uttered the rallying cry. The other demons who were late in reacting felt demoralized seeing that. They paused from joining the attack.
Jack then used Devil Blood, the active skill from the Ring of Devil Incarnate. Crimson blood vessels bulged through the draconic scales of his Supreme Dragon Form. Thin crimson mist sipped out of those blood vessels.
After that, a dark purple bubble encapsulated him. It was the Sphere of Tiamat, which had just gone off cooldown. With the boosts from the sphere and the Devil Blood, Jack charged toward
the incoming demons.

chapters.title: Chapter 1972: Chapter 1972. Destroying the Main Underworld Portal
chapters.content:
Chapter 1972:. Destroying the Main Underworld Portal
*BOOM!!*
The space shook as a shockwave reverberated through the air and slammed into the ground far below. The ground was no longer the landscape it once was. Any trees, hills, or mountains that once decorated the terrain were gone. The ground was now a flat land filled with rubble. No living things were visible in miles. Those who failed to flee far enough already died from the repeated shockwaves.
This was what happened in the area where divine beings scuffled for almost a full day.
"Begone...!!!"
A powerful rainbow energy lashed out from Lucifer's swing. Pride was smacked away by the force. A wave of chaotic rainbow energy followed. This wave pushed the other Gods and
Goddesses away.
"You seem pissed. Has Volgroth destroyed the main underworld portal?" Greed asked with a mocking tone.
Lucifer answered by pointing at him and firing a concentrated multicolor arrow. Wrath and Fear hurriedly combined their power with Greed and formed a shield that blocked the arrow. Even though they successfully blocked the arrow, they were pushed back and felt something heavy had rammed into their bodies.
Lucifer was indeed pissed, but not because of Volgroth. The main underworld portal was still standing. What pissed Lucifer off was he sensed the death of all the devils, including Satan. As much as he found that unbelievable, the disappearing links between him and the six devils were unmistakable. Only one thing explained the disappearance of these links. The devils had died.
This was an irreparable loss. He needed the devils to maintain control once they conquered the upperworld. Now, he could only rely on those lowly demons for the job. The perfect world The envisioned was now no longer possible.
To make matters worse, there was still the problem with Volgroth. Although the main underworld portal was still standing, he could sense that his barrier had lost half of its energies. He needed to get back to that portal!
"I will drag you punks into hell and torture you for eternity!!!" Lucifer shouted in fury. He spun. His six colorful wings released multicolor energies that formed a hurricane. This hurricane expanded.
"Hold him!" Wrath yelled. Fear, Greed, and she channeled their negative energies to halt the hurricane's expansion.
"Urghh...! He is too strong!!" Fear exclaimed. They were as if trying to stop a broken dam.
On the opposite side, Love and Serenity approached Pride.
"Are you fine?" Serenity asked.
Many scars were visible on Pride's armor. Its luminance, which was usually dazzling, was now rather dull. Traces of light were seen seeping out of those scars.
"Your essences are slipping," Love said with worry.
"Never mind me," Pride told them. "He is going all out. We must as well!"
"We have already gone all out," Love said.
"No. I know you haven't. Listen, you two. Stop worrying about me. If we fail to stop Lucifer here, all will be lost. Everyone and everything in this upperworld will no longer be what it used to be. Even if we survive this fight, it will be meaningless. There is no point in me surviving this, do you understand?"
The two Goddesses have complicated expressions. Serenity turned to the multicolor hurricane that was still being retained by the bad Gods' energies. The hurricane had stopped expanding, but from the expressions of the three Gods, they wouldn't be able to keep doing that for long.
"I understand," Serenity said.
"Sister...?" Love turned to Serenity in disbelief.
"As Brother Pride said. If we failed to keep Lucifer here before Volgroth completed his mission, all will be lost," Serenity said. She then turned to Pride and asked, "How long can you last if we give you our all?"
"As long as I need to," Pride answered.
Serenity nodded. She turned to Love, who was still showing a troubled expression. Under Serenity's firm gaze, Love found her resolve. She steeled her expression.
The two pushed their hands in Pride's direction at the same time. A brilliant light flowed from them and into Pride.
"Hrrgghh...!" The influx of energy took Pride by surprise. Although he had prepared himself, the power that flowed into him was still more than he expected. He felt like his body was about to explode. He clenched his fists. With a thundering roar, he forced this overflowing energy under control.
The light from Serenity and Love condensed and wrapped around his body. Pride turned into a humanoid creature made of light. None of his armor was visible under the dense light.
With another roar, he charged forward. He pierced into the multicolor hurricane and crashed straight into Lucifer, who was in the eye of the storm. A powerful shockwave radiated from the collision. The multicolor hurricane ruptured from the shockwave.
Lucifer was shocked his full-powered attempt was stopped. He was even more surprised he felt hurt from the impact just now.
"You...," Lucifer noticed the change in Pride's appearance. "You are truly ready to die...?"
"Which part of it that you don't understand?" Pride said and sent a blindingly fast punch that struck Lucifer's jaw.
Lucifer reeled from the punch but quickly returned with a punch of his own.
"So be it! Die! You, miserable pretender!" Lucifer exclaimed. His punch was equally fast. The impact generated another earth-shattering shockwave.
One day passed after Satan was defeated. At the main underworld portal, the yellow barrier covering the portal was dimming. The HP bar above the barrier was nearly depleted.
On the ground surrounding the portal were mountains of demon corpses. These were the demons who originally guarded the portal and those who were called back to defend the
portal.
Xugguth was still alive. He almost died once, though. After that, he kept his distance and used his subordinates as cannon fodders. He only attacked when Volgroth was occupied.
These demons were not Volgroth's opponents. Volgroth could have dispatched them easily, but they were still a nuisance. Their interference caused him to be unable to focus his offense on the main underworld portal. He ended up needing two days to bring down the barrier's HP. "Hmph! You, demons, truly are bothersome, but this is the end for you. Prepare to get sent back to the underworld!" Volgroth exclaimed while unleashing his Celestial Soul Breath. The silver beam vaporized the demons on its path before crashing into the yellow barrier. This attack took out the barrier's HP. The yellow barrier faded out and exposed the main
underworld portal.
"Finally!" Volgroth exclaimed. This task had taken much longer than he planned. He knew they were in a race against time. He knew the upperworld Gods were holding Lucifer down. If Lucifer returned, he would be finished. Even if he was the strongest being, he was still nothing against a God.
"I will not let you!" Xugguth came at Volgroth from behind. Now that the barrier was gone, the main underworld portal was vulnerable. He couldn't afford to play it safely anymore. No matter what, Volgroth must not destroy the portal. He had to answer to Lucifer if that happened. He feared facing Lucifer's wrath rather than losing his life because Lucifer's wrath meant unending torture where he wished he was dead.
Volgroth sensed Xugguth's approach. He easily repelled the demon using a tail swipe.
"Nothing is going to stop me from destroying that portal!" Volgroth exclaimed.
The main underworld portal itself possessed an HP bar. It would take time to destroy the portal, but Volgroth had no intention of wasting more time. He flew back, which confused the demons. Why did the dragon retreat after the portal was exposed?
